jobs.title: Senior Business Analyst - Product Master Data Processes
jobs.description:
Remote based in US/ Towson, MD

Come build something that matters.

It takes great people to achieve greatness. People with a sense of purpose and integrity. People with a relentless pursuit of excellence. People who care about making things better For Those Who Make The World™. Sound like you? Join our top-notch team of approximately 43,500 diverse and high-performing professionals globally who are making their mark on some of the world’s most beloved brands, including DEWALT®, BLACK+DECKER®, CRAFTSMAN®, STANLEY®, CUB CADET®, and HUSTLER®.

The Job:

As a Senior Business Analyst - Product Master Data Processes
, you'll be supporting the global product master data program and play a key role in shaping and scaling product master data processes that support new product setup. This role is responsible for defining future-state requirements, preparing build-ready scope for upcoming workstreams and regional expansion, and identifying opportunities to improve process efficiency, data quality, and governance.

This position is best suited for a strong business analyst with experience in process transformation
, master data
, and cross-functional requirements definition
. The role will work closely with product, business, and technology teams to ensure the organization has a steady pipeline of well-defined scope that supports delivery quality, reduces rework, and improves readiness for scale. You'll get to:

Future-State Requirements And Scope Definition

Lead or co-lead requirements gathering for upcoming product master data workstreams and regional expansion efforts
Translate business needs into clear, structured, and actionable requirements
Partner with stakeholders to define future-state workflows, process changes, and business rules
Ensure scope is sufficiently defined and ready to transition into build planning and delivery

Process Design and Improvement

Co-own identification of process improvement opportunities across in-flight and launched workstreams
Evaluate opportunities to improve speed, usability, governance, and data quality
Help shape future-state process designs that are scalable, practical, and aligned to business priorities
Support simplification and standardization of product master data processes across teams and regions

Stakeholder Engagement and Business Alignment

Work independently with cross-functional stakeholders to gather input, clarify needs, and align on requirements
Support business discussions related to process design, regional nuances, and rollout readiness
Communicate requirements, decisions, and process impacts clearly across business and delivery teams
Bring forward thoughtful recommendations and constructive challenges when opportunities for improvement are identified

Delivery Readiness Support

Support creation and refinement of user stories, acceptance criteria, and related documentation
Support prioritization discussions by helping distinguish MVP scope from future enhancements
Provide support to delivery teammates when needed, including requirements clarification and feedback translation
Contribute to change management and training support activities where appropriate

Quality and Continuous Improvement

Help improve the speed and quality of the requirements-to-build cycle
Reduce defects and rework by strengthening requirements clarity and process definition
Support stronger backlog quality through structured requirements and cleaner handoffs into delivery
Contribute to a repeatable operating model for scaling product master data processes globally

The Person:

You love to learn and grow and be acknowledged for your valuable contributions. You’re not intimidated by innovation. Wouldn’t it be great if you could do your job and do a world of good? In fact, you embrace it. You also have:

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Data Analytics, Business, Finance, Data Science, Marketing, or a related field.
Minimum of 5 years of hands-on experience in business analysis, including requirements gathering, process mapping, and future-state definition
Minimum of 3 years of experience supporting process transformation or business process improvement initiatives
Minimum of 3 years of experience working across cross-functional stakeholders in a matrixed environment
Demonstrated ability to operate independently while partnering closely with senior leaders and subject matter experts
Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to translate complex business needs into clear requirements
Working knowledge of SQL for querying, validating, and analyzing structured data.
Experience supporting enterprise data import/export processes, including integrations and ETL workflows.
Understanding of ERP systems such as SAP, JDE, or JDA.
Proficiency in PowerPoint for developing clear, professional presentations to communicate analysis, recommendations, or project updates.
3+ years of experience supporting product master data or related business processes
2+ years of experience supporting global or regional rollout efforts
2+ years of experience identifying and shaping process improvement opportunities
Familiarity with workflow-driven business processes and digital transformation initiatives
Experience supporting backlog, story, or delivery-readiness activities in partnership with product or technology teams
Advanced Microsoft Excel skills; experienced in MS Office Suite.

The Details:

You’ll receive a competitive salary and a great benefits plan, including:

Medical, dental, life, vision, disability, 401(k), Employee Stock Purchase Plan, paid time off, and tuition reimbursement in addition to programs & benefits in support of your well-being.
Discounts on Stanley Black & Decker tools and other partner programs.

And More:

We want our company to be a place you’ll want to be – and stay. Being part of our team means you’ll get to:

Grow: Be part of our global company with 20+ brands to grow and develop your skills along multiple career paths.
Learn: Have access to a wealth of learning resources, including our digital learning portal.
Belong: Experience an awesome place to work, where we have mutual respect and a great appreciation for a wide range of perspectives and experiences.
Give Back: Help us continue to make positive changes locally and globally through volunteerism, giving back, and sustainable business practices.

What’s more, you’ll get that pride that comes from empowering makers, doers, protectors, and everyday heroes all over the world. We’re more than the #1 tools company. More than a driving force in outdoor power equipment. More than a global leader in industrial. We’re visionaries and innovators. As successful as we’ve been in the past, we have so much further to go. That’s where you come in. Join us!

The Salary range for this position is $90,000.00 - $144,900.00

This is the lowest to highest annual full-time salary range we would pay for this role at the time of this posting. The salary offered within the range may vary depending on multiple factors including job level, geographic location, job-related knowledge, skills, qualifications, experience and in compliance with local wage requirements. Please note that salary is only one component of total rewards at Stanley Black & Decker.
The salary range listed in this job posting reflects the range for the primary location specified. The salary range may vary for other locations.
The successful candidate may be eligible for annual merit increases.
Medical, dental, life, vision, disability,401(k), Employee Stock Purchase Plan, paid time off, and tuition reimbursement in addition to programs & benefits in support of your well-being.
Discounts on Stanley Black & Decker tool sand other partner programs.

We Don’t Just Build The World, We Build Innovative Technology Too.

Joining the Stanley Black & Decker team means working in an innovative, tech-driven and highly collaborative team environment supported by over 43,500 professionals in 60 countries across the globe. Here, you’ll get the unique chance to impact some of the world’s most iconic brands including STANLEY TOOLS, DEWALT, CRAFTSMAN, MAC TOOLS and Black + Decker. Your ideas and solutions have the potential to reach millions of customers as we work together to write the next chapter in our history. Come build with us and take your career to new heights.

Who We Are

We’re the World’s largest tool company. We’re industry visionaries. We’re solving problems and advancing the manufacturing trade through innovative technology and our Industry 4.0 Initiative. We are committed to ensuring our state-of-the-art “smart factory” products and services provide greater quality to our customers & greater environmental and social value to our planet. We are unique in that we have a rich and storied history dating back to 1843, but that hasn't stopped us from evolving into a vibrant, diverse, global growth company.

What You’ll Also Get

Career Opportunity: Career paths aren’t linear here. Being part of our global company with 60+ brands gives you the chance to grow and develop your skills along multiple career paths.

Benefits & Perks

You’ll get a competitive salary and a comprehensive benefits plan that includes medical, dental, life, vision, wellness program, disability, retirement benefits, Employee Stock Purchase Plan, Paid Time Off, including paid vacation, holidays & personal days, and tuition reimbursement. And, of course, discounts on Stanley Black & Decker tools and products and well as discount programs for many other vendors and partners.

Learning & Development:

Our lifelong learning philosophy means you’ll have access to a wealth of state-of-the-art learning resources, including our Lean Academy and online university (where you can get certificates and specializations from renowned colleges and universities).

Diverse & Inclusive Culture:

We pride ourselves on being an awesome place to work. We respect and embrace differences because that’s how the best work gets done. You’ll find we like to have fun here, too.

Purpose-Driven Company:

You’ll help us continue to make positive changes in the local communities where we work and live as well as in the broader world through volunteerism, giving back and sustainable business practices.

jobs.title: Washington, DC - Global Project Manager
jobs.description:
About Us

At Winston Taylor, we set the standard, together.

Winston Taylor is a transatlantic law firm built for the businesses, people, and markets driving capital and innovation. Here, you're in the room. In the action. Sleeves rolled up. You'll work with leading clients. Disruptors. Fast-growth companies. And help them to stay one step ahead of the moment and make critical decisions that shape their future. We're present in the U.S., U.K., Europe, Latin America, and the Middle East, combining the scale and speed that clients demand. You'll be trusted with real responsibility from the outset and build experience through hands-on work. We take your progression personally. We provide the platform. You shape the work around your goals and aspirations. Step into the moments that matter. Join Winston Taylor.

Position Summary

Winston Taylor’s Project Management Office (PMO) has a wide scope of responsibilities, including initiatives across the firm’s global departments and practices. This role partners with both staff and attorney stakeholders to scope, plan, and manage medium to high complexity projects on a global scale – including but not limited to: business process improvements, office moves, technology product implementations, and business development special projects. It is responsible for the creation and delivery of project plans that support business solutions and to meet the firm’s evolving needs by improving current processes. In addition, this role will serve as the liaison between the customer community and the technical teams, ensuring that documented requirements are implemented to the project stakeholder’s satisfaction.

The project management team has regular engagement with top firm leadership and is expected to play a meaningful role in executing on business and technology initiatives that impact the Firm’s clients, the Firm’s competitiveness, and the quality of working environment for all employees. Therefore, each project manager on this team is critical and is expected to meaningfully define and drive progress, not just passively establish and document meetings.

Position Responsibilities

Partner with project sponsors or subject matter experts to identify and document a project’s business requirements with a focus on increasing business effectiveness and efficiencies, including development of project feasibility and cost-benefit analyses.
Lead and facilitate project meetings ensuring effective and timely communication across the project team, especially among project stakeholders and PMO leadership.
Prepare project charters and project plans and deliver projects within allocated time and resource targets to satisfy the defined scope and quality.
Identify risks, manage scope changes and resource constraints, and develop mitigation strategies as needed.
Drive decision-making and escalation among project stakeholders, PMO leadership, and firm leadership, when appropriate.
Continuously improve upon existing project management methodology. Assist with the expansion of the firm’s project management methodology, best practices, and tools
Prepare recommendations for technological and business solutions based on project requirements.
Develop and maintain project objective(s), scope, and work plan related to software development, implementations of new or modified applications, and business processes.
Communicate with project teams and management regarding the status of all ongoing projects including project issues and accomplishments. Ensure completion of project deliverables based on identified requirements and approved timeline.
Work closely with the Quality Assurance Manager and Business Analyst roles to monitor and track defects (including gaps from stakeholder requirements or ease of use) identified during testing through resolution.
Work closely with Change Managers to support organizational readiness, stakeholder engagement, communications, training, and adoption activities, ensuring successful implementation and sustained realization of project objectives.
Coordinate project rollout to the user community, including communications, documentation, reference guides and demonstrations.
Understand integrations between all applications/systems maintained by the Firm.
Research and analyze new technologies. Maintain professional and technical knowledge by attending educational workshops, reviewing professional publications, and establishing personal networks.
Perform other duties as assigned.

Experience, Skills, And Qualifications

Bachelor’s Degree is required.
3+ years of project management experience in a law firm or relevant professional services environment required.
Must live within a commutable distance to a firm office with ability to come into the office 3-4 days per week.
Advanced knowledge of project management methodologies and tools.
Strong leadership, prioritization, and organization skills.
Ability to develop and maintain ongoing relationships with firm leadership, customers, stakeholders, and project sponsors.
Excellent oral and written communication skills. Ability to present detailed or complicated information in an understandable way to firm attorneys and staff.
Strong information gathering and problem-solving skills. Demonstrated ability to apply critical thinking to complex situations.
Experience working with and collaborating among interdisciplinary teams to identify and solve complex business problems.
Experience managing projects associated with mergers, acquisitions, and organizational integrations, including coordination of cross-functional teams, dependencies, risks, and business transition activities.
Skilled in conveying business requirements to the appropriate business leaders and/or IS team members and, where necessary, with vendors.
Capable of overseeing technical creation and implementation of business solutions.
Experience with testing to ensure completion of project deliverables.
Experience in information systems and/or applying technology solutions to business processes.
Experience with non-US operations especially in Europe and Asia are beneficial.

Benefits

Winston offers comprehensive benefits that provide a full spectrum of coverage and support for our full-time employees and their families. Additional information about benefits and rewards can be found here .

Salary

Illinois

based applicants only:
The target annual salary range for this role is currently $115,000 - $147,000 based on a regular, full-time schedule. The amount of compensation offered will be determined by several factors, including but not limited to experience, qualifications, market data and internal equity. To tal compensation includes a comprehensive healthcare benefits package, yearly retirement contribution, and may include an annual discretionary merit bonus.

New York
based applicants only:
The target annual salary range for this role is currently $125,000 - $160,000 based on a regular, full-time schedule. The amount of compensation offered will be determined by several factors, including but not limited to experience, qualifications, market data and internal equity. To tal compensation includes a comprehensive healthcare benefits package, yearly retirement contribution, and may include an annual discretionary merit bonus.

Washington, DC based applicants only:
The target annual salary range for this role is currently $120,000 - $155,000 based on a regular, full-time schedule. The amount of compensation offered will be determined by several factors, including but not limited to experience, qualifications, market data and internal equity. To tal compensation includes a comprehensive healthcare benefits package, yearly retirement contribution, and may include an annual discretionary merit bonus.

We are an equal opportunity employer and welcome applicants from all backgrounds and experien ces.

jobs.title: Project Manager
jobs.description:
TFS HealthScience is a leading global mid-size Contract Research Organization (CRO) that partners with biotechnology and pharmaceutical companies throughout their entire clinical development journey. Our expertise includes full service-capabilities, resourcing and Functional Service (FSP) solutions.

Join Our Team as a Project Manager [1.0 FTE] - (home based in US).

About This Role

As part of our CDS Ophthalmology
teams you will be working alongside passionate and innovative professionals to ensure our customers achieve their goals.
The Project Manager
will plan and pro-actively manage multidisciplinary study teams (including Site Management, Data Management, Statistics, Medical Writing, Regulatory and Safety) to ensure key milestones are achieved and studies are performed within budget, on schedule and in compliance with the appropriate - and quality standards.

Key Responsibilities

Ensure that projects are delivered on-time, within scope and within budget and in compliance with applicable quality standards.
Manages the strategic aspects of projects, identify, analyze and minimize/mitigates any risk, including the implications of difference technical and operational choices.
Communicates effectively with clients to successfully manage the relationship, identify needs and evaluate alternative business solutions and strategies.
Develop and maintain Project Plans and timelines for their project and track progress.
Ensure all study team members -are adequately trained on project specific systems and procedures.
Implements, and maintains sound business practices.
Measure and evaluate project performance.
Manage the project budget, profitability and ensure invoicing is performed on time and in accordance with the scope of work.
Working with the Finance & Accounting team to analyze profitability, revenue, margins and utilization across their projects..
Manage the resource allocation, on the project, in collaboration with respective line managers.
Facilitate internal and external communication.
Report and escalate to management as needed.
Establish and maintain relationship with third parties/vendors.
Manages high-level deliverables across the organization.
Participate in capability presentations/bid defenses, as needed.
Continually defines ways to increase customer satisfaction and deepen client relationships.
Contribute in review/develop procedures, guidelines, SOPs, metrics as needed

Qualifications

Bachelor’s Degree, preferably in life science or RN diploma.
3 year of relevant experience in clinical research.
Knowledge of clinical research regulations governing the conduct of the clinical trials and quality standards.
Understanding of project planning and metrics.
Ability to lead and manage staff.
Excellent oral and written communication skills in English.
Solid organizational skills and ability to prioritize.
Internal and external negotiation skills.
Ability and willingness to travel to 10%

What We Offer

We provide a competitive compensation package, comprehensive benefits and the opportunity for personal and professional growth in a rewarding environment. You’ll be joining a team that values collaboration, innovation, and making a difference in the lives of patients

A Bit More About Us

Our journey began over 30 years ago in Sweden, in the city of Lund. As a full-service, global Contract Research Organization (CRO), we build solution-driven teams working towards a healthier future. Bringing together over 600 professionals, TFS delivers tailored clinical research services in more than 50 countries with flexible clinical development and strategic resourcing solutions across key therapeutic areas including Dermatology, Neuroscience, Oncology and Ophthalmology.
Our core values of Trust, Quality, Passion, Flexibility, and Sustainability are our guiding light serving as the framework for decision-making at all levels of the organization. They assist us in attracting and retaining valuable talent who share our sentiments, resulting in high employee engagement and satisfaction. By aligning on these fundamental values, we cultivate a unified force, geared towards innovation and excellence. This collective effort propels us towards our shared goal and fosters a culture of mutual respect and collaboration.
Together we make a difference.

jobs.title: Implementation Program Manager - Investment Management Technology (Required)
jobs.description:
PLEASE NOTE: Investment/Asset Management platform experience is required (e.g. Charles River, Eagle, Clearwater, Aladdin, SimCorp, or comparable)

Implementation Program Manager - Investment Management Technology

Location:
Remote - US
Type
: Full-time, Permanent
Travel:
As needed, approximately once per month to client locations in California

About Cutter:

At Cutter Associates, we empower the world’s leading asset managers and asset owners with the intelligence they need to stay ahead. For nearly 30 years, and with a global presence, we’ve combined expert consulting with proprietary research and industry benchmarking to help top-tier investment firms make smarter, faster decisions. Our global team is known for its deep domain expertise, collaborative spirit, and relentless curiosity. As we expand into new markets and capabilities, now is the perfect time to grow your career with a company that values insight, innovation, and impact.

As we expand our reach and deepen our impact, we're seeking an experienced Project / Program Manager to lead complex investment management technology implementations for institutional asset management clients. This is a full-time, permanent position supporting multiple consulting engagements across our practices.

The ideal candidate brings deep knowledge of investment management systems and business processes, a strong track record of leading enterprise technology implementations, and the ability to engage confidently with senior executives. This individual will oversee project delivery, manage vendor relationships, and guide clients through critical decisions to ensure successful outcomes.

Role and Responsibilities:

Lead large-scale investment management technology implementations, overseeing project planning, execution, governance, and delivery.
Serve as a trusted advisor to senior client stakeholders, including executive leadership and steering committees.
Manage third-party technology vendors, ensuring accountability for deliverables, timelines, and commitments.
Coordinate cross-functional teams, including client stakeholders, vendors, and Cutter consulting resources.
Develop and maintain project plans, status reports, risk assessments, and executive-level presentations.
Facilitate critical project decisions, proactively identifying risks, dependencies, and opportunities for improvement.
Support multiple client engagements and collaborate across Cutter's consulting practices as business needs evolve.

Qualifications:

Required

15+ years of experience in investment management technology, consulting, or transformation, including significant project/program management experience.
Proven experience leading complex investment management system implementations for asset managers, asset owners, or institutional investment organizations.
Strong understanding of front-, middle-, and back-office investment management workflows and technology platforms.
Demonstrated experience managing third-party vendors, implementation partners, and cross-functional delivery teams.
Exceptional executive communication and stakeholder management skills, including experience presenting to steering committees and boards.
Strong program governance, project planning, risk management, and problem-solving capabilities.
Ability to operate independently, manage competing priorities, and provide strategic guidance while remaining actively involved in delivery.

Preferred

Experience implementing or overseeing platforms such as Charles River, Eagle, Clearwater, Aladdin, SimCorp, or comparable investment management systems.
Prior consulting experience supporting institutional investment management clients.
Experience managing enterprise-wide technology modernization or platform transformation initiatives.
PMP or equivalent project management certification.

Why Cutter:

At Cutter Associates, we believe people do their best work when they’re trusted, supported, and empowered to thrive - wherever they are.
Established credibility, entrepreneurial spirit
– Founded in 1998 and backed by Nomura Research Institute (NRI), we blend the stability of a global research and technology powerhouse with the agility of a small, fast-moving firm.
Global reach

Company Description

Galileo Learning’s mission is to develop innovators who envision and create a better world.

We provide out-of-school enrichment programs that build innovation skills, growth mindset, and creative confidence across a variety of offerings. We run neighborhood summer day camps for families, deliver expanded learning programs for school districts, and empower educational institutions and service providers with curriculum and instructional support.

We bring our mission to life through the Galileo Innovation Approach (GIA): combining mindset, process, and knowledge to drive meaningful outcomes for students and for each other. This shows up in how we collaborate, make decisions, and continuously improve our work.

We Are

Visionary: We think beyond what exists today and work toward what’s possible.
Courageous: We take ownership, make decisions with imperfect information, and lean into challenges.
Collaborative: We work across teams and perspectives, assuming positive intent and building strong partnerships.
Determined: We follow through, hold a high bar for quality, and stay focused on delivering results that matter for our students and partners
Reflective: We learn from experience, use data and feedback to improve, and continuously evolve how we work.

We operate with a high level of ownership and care for our work, our partners, and each other.

Job Description

Galileo is looking for an experienced leader to join our team as a Field Program Manager. As Galileo grows our presence and sites throughout Orange County, this role will be instrumental in partnering with district expanded learning programs and creating a best-in-class staff experience for our Camp Directors and summer staff. The Field Program Manager will support camp operations and marketing across the region. An ideal candidate will be passionate about and experienced with bringing programming to under-served communities and inspired by Galileo’s potential impact.

You will be Accountable For

Drive operational excellence across a portfolio of sites throughout the greater Orange County region, partnering with district leadership to provide impact-driven ELOP services in under-served communities.
Manage a team of Camp Directors; creating professional development opportunities, giving timely feedback, and ensuring safe, welcoming staff teams that value belonging, joy, and camp innovation & fun.
Partnering with the Area Director, develop camp operating plans for each managed site and train Camp Directors on all logistics and operations. Manage Camp Directors to execute day to day site logistics and partnership on site.
In partnership with the L&D team, develop content for training Camp Directors, including facilitating retreat logistics and content, developing coaching materials, and deploying coaching capacity across sites.
Foster relationships in the community through networking and building relationships with district and school site partners and families.
Serve as an escalation point for your team on issues or challenges that they do not feel prepared to resolve on their own; assist in resolution that balances customer care and program needs.
Monitor and respond to feedback from district partners and staff based on on-site observation–to identify and mitigate challenges and performance gaps.
Partner with our People Operations Team to hire, onboard, train, and support our Camp Director team throughout the hiring process and the pre-camp season.
Serve as the cross-departmental partner with marketing, customer service, training, the people operations department, and the supply team to identify and implement customizations to existing operations based on district needs.
In partnership with Account Manager, refine KPIs for each camp and capture performance data.

YOU ARE

Strategic, organized and performance-driven. Problem-solving makes you downright giddy. You look at the details of life through a lens of optimization, measurement, and efficiency and feel responsible for getting things done.
Adaptable and action-oriented. You can manage a variety of projects simultaneously. Changing deadlines? Multiple stakeholders? Easy breezy. You manage your time well and are meticulous about the details.
A visionary collaborator. You can confidently contribute to a creative vision and have the team-oriented mindset to work with others to realize it effectively.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience
Experience in multi-site staff management and managing programs or services
Experience with marketing and community communications preferred
Minimum 2 years experience working with K-8 education; experience working at camps and/or out-of-school time programs a bonus
Minimum 3 years experience managing individuals and a team
Experience with staff hiring, recruiting, training, development, and feedback a must
Ability to travel in and around the Greater Orange County region
Experience with B2B sales or account management is a plus

We strongly encourage applications from individuals of all backgrounds and experiences, and we are committed to equitable and inclusive hiring practices. If you think you have what it takes to be successful in this role, we encourage you to apply!

Work Location

This role is primarily remote, work-from-home, based out of Orange County.

HQ staff may be expected to visit camp locations or clients to experience Camp Galileo and Galileo X Solutions first-hand. Occasionally, onsite events or meetings may also be required. 10-15% travel may be required, depending on location.

Schedule & Time Commitment

This is a full-time position, averaging 40 hours per week. While we prioritize work-life balance, there may be times when additional hours are necessary to meet deadlines and ensure the success of our programs.

Compensation

We anticipate the compensation for this full-time, exempt, position to be $80,000 - $90,000. Exact compensation may vary and will be based on multiple factors, including geography and professional experience.

Our pay practices are guided by a commitment to equity and informed by market benchmarking and internal audits to minimize bias and ensure fairness across all roles.

No-cost medical insurance for employees (additional plans and options to add dependents available at cost)
Vision and Dental Insurance
401k benefits after 1 year of employment
Flexible Paid Time Off - time off is not limited, and we strongly recommend that employees take time off to rest and recharge.
Unlimited free camp for your child(ren), OR two free weeks to be gifted (including AM/PM Extended Care)
Friends and Family Discount for Galileo Camps
Priority scholarship nominations for Galileo Camps
Generous parental leave and extensive support with leave planning
Employee Assistance Program, options for life insurance, and more!

We comply with the ADA and provide reasonable accommodations that allow qualified applicants/employees to perform the essential functions of the job. To request an accommodation, contact our Human Resources team.

Rivian is on a mission to keep the world adventurous forever. This goes for the emissions-free Electric Adventure Vehicles we build, and the curious, courageous souls we seek to attract.

We are seeking a Program Manager to help fulfill the goals of the broader Benchmarking Program: Drive product excellence by equipping product development and manufacturing engineering teams with asset and test assets, as well as data-driven insights derived from competitive benchmarking, market analysis, and comprehensive vehicle evaluations.

This position will work closely with all areas of Product Development, Manufacturing, Service, and other teams and support ongoing programs related to Benchmarking by leading and assisting with the execution of projects. This Program Manager role will require exceptional cross-functional interaction, attention to detail, great organizational and planning skills, program management knowledge, capability of data analysis and visualization, as well as excellent verbal and written communication skills.

Responsibilities

Ensure timely completion of all programs and projects.
Own the scope, road map, and tracking of projects and/or programs from start to finish .
Set and track deliverables, identify risks and drive mitigations across all stages of the project.
Anticipate, plan and coordinate internal logistics/needs across projects.
Develop tools and analytics for project reporting, enabling cross functional teams to focus more efforts on problem solving, and engineering.
Drive initiatives cross functionally with relevant stakeholders within and outside of Test and Development.
Partner with cross functional leads, and others to ensure milestones are met and project is a success.
Performs other duties as required or assigned within the scope of the position.

Qualifications

2+ years of experience in a related professional and dynamic environment.
4-year college/university degree or similar/equivalent work experience in operations or related field.
Program management, engineering, business analytics, data visualization, consulting or similar project execution experience preferred.
Experience managing multiple projects simultaneously, working closely with cross-functional teams and stakeholders.
Strong communication and interpersonal skills, ability to explain technical concepts to non-engineers.
Data skills: SQL, agentic AI, JIRA, Google workspace, CANalyzer, and more
You aren't afraid to get your hands dirty in the lab to understand why a data point looks "off."

The salary range for this role is $77,300 - $85,900 for California based applicants. An employee’s position within the salary range will be based on several factors including, but not limited to, specific competencies, relevant education, qualifications, certifications, experience, skills, geographic location, shift, and organizational needs.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, ancestry, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender expression, gender identity, genetic information or characteristics, physical or mental disability, marital/domestic partner status, age, military/veteran status, medical condition, or any other characteristic protected by law.

Candidate Data Privacy and Technology

This data includes contact, demographic, communications, educational, professional, employment, social media/website, network/device, recruiting system usage/interaction, security and preference information. jobs.description:
When you join the growing BILH team, you're not just taking a job, you’re making a difference in people’s lives.

Under the general direction of the Director of IT Project Management, the Senior IT Project Manager (Sr. IT PM) leads one or more high impact strategic initiatives that enhance clinical, operational, and administrative systems across the organization. The Sr. IT PM is responsible for ensuring that all assigned projects are delivered on time, within scope and budget, and in accordance with established quality standards. This role works collaboratively with executive leadership, clinical, operational, and technical teams to plan, implement, and

oversee initiatives that advance organizational goals and improve patient care through technology.

The Sr. IT PM serves as a key liaison among business units, project committees, the Information Services department, and external vendors providing IT services. Additionally, the Sr. IT PM mentors and guides project team members, fostering a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

Job Description

Essential Responsibilities:

Lead the planning, execution, and successful delivery of multiple concurrent Healthcare IT projects from initiation through implementation and stabilization.
Develop and manage comprehensive project plans, including scope, timelines, budgets, resources, risk mitigation, and communication strategies.
Ensure adherence to BILH PMO standards, methodologies, and governance frameworks.
Partner with stakeholders across clinical, business, and technical areas to define project objectives, success metrics, and deliverables.
Identify, assess, and proactively mitigate project risks and issues to maintain momentum and stakeholder confidence.
Accurately estimate and manage required resources to achieve project milestones within scope and schedule.
Provide clear and timely communication of project updates, expectations, and changes to sponsors and stakeholders through dashboards, reports, and presentations.
Oversee vendor performance and contracts, ensuring alignment with project goals and service expectations.
Resolve conflicts and address project-related challenges through effective collaboration and negotiation.
Manage scope changes, identify potential impacts, and implement contingency plans as needed.
Contribute to the ongoing enhancement of PMO processes, tools, and best practices to improve delivery efficiency and outcomes

Required Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Business Administration, Healthcare Management, or a related field required. Master’s degree preferred.
Minimum of 10+ years of progressive project management experience, including 8+ years in healthcare IT or a comparable regulated environment
PMP certification is required.
Proven success managing large-scale, cross-functional initiatives involving EHR systems, clinical applications, or enterprise infrastructure.
Demonstrated ability to manage competing priorities and deliver measurable results within a complex, matrixed organization.
In-depth understanding of the full project management lifecycle and practical application of methodologies, including Waterfall, Agile, and hybrid models.
Strong technical acumen across IT domains such as cybersecurity, networking, infrastructure, end-user computing, telecom, and data analytics.
Experience managing third-party vendors and contracts, including performance oversight and coordination of external teams.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to engage and influence stakeholders at all levels of the organization.
Advanced Proficiency with project management tools such as Smartsheet, Microsoft Project, or equivalent platforms.
Advanced proficiency with Microsoft 365 applications (Teams, SharePoint, Word, Excel, PowerPoint).

Competencies

Decision Making: Ability to make decisions that are guided by precedents, policies and objectives. Regularly makes decisions and recommendations on issues affecting a department or functional area. Problem Solving: Ability to address problems that are highly varied, complex and often non-recurring, requiring staff input, innovative, creative, and Lean diagnostic techniques to resolve issues. Independence of Action: Ability to set goals and determines how to accomplish defined results with some guidelines. Manager/Director provides broad guidance and overall direction. Written Communications: Ability to summarize and communicate in English moderately complex information in varied written formats to internal and external customers. Oral Communications: Ability to comprehend and communicate complex verbal information in English to medical center staff, patients, families and external customers. Knowledge: Ability to demonstrate in-depth knowledge of concepts, practices and policies with the ability to use them in complex varied situations. Team Work: Ability to lead collaborative teams for larger projects or groups both internal and external to the Medical Center and across functional areas. Results have implications for the management and operations of multiple areas of the organization. Customer Service: Ability to provide a high level of customer service to patients, visitors, staff and external customers in a professional, service-oriented, respectful manner using skills in active listening and problem solving. Ability to remain calm in stressful situations.

Physical Nature Of The Job

Sedentary work: Exerting up to 10 pounds of force occasionally in carrying, lifting, pushing, pulling objects. Sitting most of the time, with walking and standing required only occasionally

Pay Range

$118,560.00 USD - $156,000.00 USD

The pay range listed for this position is the annual base salary range the organization reasonably and in good faith expects to pay for this position at this time. Actual compensation is determined based on several factors, that may include seniority, education, training, relevant experience, relevant certifications, geography of work location, job responsibilities, or other applicable factors permissible by law.

jobs.title: Program Manager Health Equity
jobs.description:
When you join the growing BILH team, you're not just taking a job, you’re making a difference in people’s lives.

Beth Israel Lahey Health (BILH) aims to transform care delivery by dismantling barriers to equitable health outcomes. The Health Equity Program Manager will contribute to achieving this vision through partnership with local senior leadership and business leaders to reduce health disparities, structural barriers to health, and to improve equitable health outcomes. The Health Equity Program Manager plays a leadership role in establishing strategic direction and integration across a large and highly complex delivery system, responsible for successful prioritization, design and execution of system improvements and programs that achieve local goals, in alignment with BILH’s Health Equity and quality goals.

The Health Equity Program Manager will work with hospital leaders on the successful implementation of a portfolio of projects and initiatives to include the 1115 MassHealth Waiver, the Joint Commission Excellent Health Outcomes for All Certification, CMS, and payer contractual requirements.

Job Description

Primary Responsibilities:

Leads the implementation of health equity priorities, data standards, disparity analysis, interventions, and outcomes measurement.
Supports the development and implementation of BILH’s health equity strategy and ensures that health equity is integrated across the organization’s policies, programs, protocols, and services.
Collaborates in a cross-functional team to identify policies, strategies, and/or programs to advance health equity through BILH driven initiatives and programs.
Designs, leads, and manages various projects and initiatives that require broad organizational support and input from multiple stakeholders.
Oversees the performance of quantitative analysis to support the implementation and monitoring of health equity initiatives as well as coordination and of tracking and reporting of milestones and synergy realization.
Maintains detailed project documentation including meeting minutes, action items, work plans, issues lists, and risk management plans.

Required Qualifications

Master's degree in health care, business administration, Public Health, or a quality related health care field.
2-4 of progressively responsible roles leading health equity, population health management, quality improvement initiatives, and/or public health efforts.
Strong knowledge of the regulatory requirements and submissions associated with the Mass. Executive Office of Health and Human. Services, National Commission for Quality Assurance, and Center for Medicaid and Medicare Services.
In-depth knowledge of public health, social determinants of health and systemic barriers that contribute to health inequities and experience embedding health equity into policies and procedures.
Demonstrated excellent interpersonal, oral, and written communications skills.
Demonstrated strong project management skills.
Proficiency with Microsoft Office (e.g., Word, Excel, Outlook, PowerPoint, OneNote, Teams).
Excellent analytical skills and ability to synthesize data from multiple sources into crisp, compelling, and sound analysis.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience working with NCQA, Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services (CMS), and other state and federal regulatory and accreditation requirements.
Experience implementing grants to meet budgetary and programmatic goals.
Experience with using population and program data to inform strategic and programmatic decisions.
Innovative thinker, with a track record for translating strategic thinking into action plans and results.

Competencies

Ability to manage multiple projects, meet deadlines and adjust to changes in company policies, procedures and priorities.
Ability to effectively present information and respond to inquiries from employees, senior management and regulatory agencies.
Ability to make decisions guided by general instruction and practices requiring some interpretation.
Ability to address problems that are varied, requiring analysis or interpretation of the situation using direct observations, knowledge and skills based on general precedents. Make problem-solving recommendations of moderate complexity and importance.
Ability to follow precedents and procedures. May set priorities and organize work within general guidelines. Seek assistance when confronted with difficult and/or unpredictable situations. Supervisor/manager will monitor work progress.
Ability to communicate clearly and effectively in written English with internal and external stakeholders.
Ability to act as a team leader for small projects or work groups, creating a collaborative and respectful team environment and improving workflows. Results may affect the operations of one or more departments.
Ability to provide a high level of customer service and staff training to meet department standards and expectations.
Ability to be accountable for delivering high-quality work and act with a clear sense of ownership.

Reporting and Key Relationships:
The Health Equity Program Manager will report to the BILH Vice President of Health Equity with a dotted line to the hospital health equity leader within the designated hospitals.

jobs.title: Senior Project Manager- Electrical (Design and Construction)
jobs.description:
Brailsford & Dunlavey (B&D), which now includes Project Management Advisors (PMA), is seeking a Senior Project Manager to join our Life Sciences team in San Francisco

This is a hybrid role based in the San Francisco Bay Area.

The Opportunity

An opportunity for a driven project management professional who thrives in fast-paced environments, enjoys collaborating with clients and project teams, and is motivated to deliver complex real estate and infrastructure projects that support the future of technology and innovation.

At Brailsford & Dunlavey (B&D), we lead the planning, development, and management of the places that shape and strengthen communities—where people live, learn, work, and innovate. B&D partners with institutions, municipalities, and organizations to deliver complex real estate and capital projects through strategic advisory and program management services across the full project lifecycle.

B&D recently joined forces with Project Management Advisors (PMA), bringing together two nationally recognized leaders in program management and real estate advisory services. Together, the combined firm offers expanded capabilities across industries and end-to-end project delivery—from early-stage strategy through design, construction, and occupancy.

As a Senior Project Manager, you will work directly with clients, architects, engineers, contractors, consultants, and project teams to support planning, design, and construction activities for new buildings, tenant improvements, infrastructure projects, and facility assignments.

How You'll Contribute

Serve as the primary point of contact between clients and project teams throughout the project lifecycle, focused on Electrical systems and Fire Alarm/Life Safety systems.
Coordinate and manage regular design meetings and specific discussions with the client, consultants, contractors, etc.; document discussions, and track action items to maintain accountability
Drive the creation of Electrical and Fire Alarm/Life Safety documents to support project execution
Review project requirements and program objectives and confirm incorporation into consultant deliverables
Coordinate procurement of design, construction, and consultant services
Support contract development, review, negotiation, and administration for project-related agreements; coordinate specialty consultants and peer reviews as needed
Develop, monitor, and maintain project budgets, schedules, and project controls; support evaluation of potential changes to project scope, budget, and schedule
Analyze project budgets and schedules and identify potential impacts to financial and operational objectives
Participate in value engineering discussions and review project alternatives with clients and teams
Build strong partnerships with clients, architects, engineers, contractors, consultants, and other project stakeholders
Collaborate with clients and project teams to identify risks, resolve issues, and maintain project momentum
Support Project team and/or mentor internal project resources, including Assistant Project Managers and Project Managers.
Monitor construction activities and confirm alignment with design intent, contract requirements, schedules, and quality standards; observe and report on construction progress and project-related issues
Support and coordinate successful project closeout and transition/training activities

What We're Looking For

10+ years of experience in an electrical-affiliated role- project management, design, coordination, construction, or operations
Experience supporting complex technology, infrastructure, mission-critical, laboratory, or commercial projects is preferred
Bachelor’s degree or higher in Mechanical or Electrical Engineering, Construction Management, Architecture, or a related field. And/or electrical engineering-focused construction, design/build experience
Demonstrated ability to successfully manage projects and consistently meet or exceed client expectations and deadlines
Strong understanding of design and construction processes, project controls, documentation, and sequencing
Experience managing project budgets, schedules, and reporting tools
Ability to interpret architectural, engineering, and construction documentation
Strong communication and relationship management skills with clients, consultants, contractors, and internal teams
Experience supporting procurement, contracts, and consultant coordination
Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment

What Sets You Apart

You are a proactive self-starter who takes ownership of project outcomes
You bring strong interpersonal skills and emotional intelligence to client and team interactions
You are highly organized and detail-oriented when managing project information, schedules, and budgets
You approach challenges with curiosity and a solution-oriented mindset
You are comfortable collaborating with technical teams and senior stakeholders
You demonstrate professionalism, integrity, and sound judgment in all interactions
You are adaptable and thrive in complex, evolving project environments
You are motivated by delivering projects that support innovation and business growth
You enjoy building relationships and contributing to a collaborative team culture

Why People Choose B&D

Impactful Mission

Be part of meaningful work that helps shape the places where people live, learn, heal, work, and connect.

Learning & Growth

We invest in mentorship, leadership development, and continuous learning at every stage of your career.

Strong Culture

Entrepreneurial thinking, collaboration, intellectual curiosity, integrity, and excellence drive how we work together.

Robust Benefits

Comprehensive benefits include medical, dental, and vision coverage, retirement benefits, professional development support, paid time off, and more.

Apply Today!

To get started, our application process includes a resume, an optional (recommended) cover letter, and a short set of essential questions. We look forward to getting to know you!

jobs.title: Technical Project Manager
jobs.description:
Description

Technical Project Manager

Shape the Future of Cybersecurity at Forescout

Every day cyberattacks threaten to disrupt hospitals, power grids, financial systems, and the infrastructure we all depend on. At Forescout, we build defenses that keep civilization running smoothly in an increasingly connected world.

For more than 25 years, Fortune 100 organizations, government agencies, and large enterprises have trusted Forescout as their foundation to manage cyber risk, ensure compliance, and mitigate threats. From power grids and healthcare systems to financial networks and transportation hubs, Forescout protects the critical infrastructure of our modern world.

The Engineering Project Management team plays a critical role in enabling Engineering, Quality Assurance, Product Management, and other technology teams to work efficiently and consistently. This position will be responsible for administering and optimizing Jira and related Atlassian tools, supporting operational processes, developing meaningful reporting and dashboards, and identifying opportunities to improve efficiency through automation and process improvement.

We are looking for a mid-to-senior level professional who combines strong Jira administration expertise with excellent problem-solving, organizational, and communication skills. The ideal candidate understands how software development and engineering organizations operate and can translate business and operational needs into practical Jira solutions.

This role will work closely with Engineering, QA, Product Management, Project Management, and other cross-functional teams to ensure Jira remains an effective system for managing work, tracking progress, measuring performance, and supporting organizational decision-making.

This position is intended for a mid-to-senior level professional who has demonstrated hands-on Jira administration experience and the ability to independently manage operational improvements in a software development environment.

Ownership

What You Will Do

Takes responsibility for systems, processes, and outcomes rather than simply responding to requests. Proactively identifies problems and opportunities for improvement.

Problem-Solving

Can investigate complex system or process issues, understand root causes, evaluate alternatives, and implement practical solutions.

Process-Oriented

Understands the importance of consistent processes, data quality, documentation, and governance while recognizing when processes should be improved.

Customer Focus

Approaches Jira administration from the perspective of the teams using the system and seeks solutions that make it easier for teams to accomplish their work.

Communication

Can clearly explain Jira capabilities, technical concepts, processes, and recommendations to both technical and non-technical audiences.

Collaboration

Builds effective relationships across Engineering, QA, Product Management, Project Management, and other functions. Can balance individual team needs with broader organizational standards.

Continuous Improvement Mindset

Constantly looks for ways to eliminate unnecessary work, improve data quality, automate repetitive activities, and make engineering operations more efficient.

What You Bring To Forescout

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Business, Engineering, or a related field preferred. Equivalent professional experience may be considered.
2–3+ years of hands-on Jira administration experience in a large or complex enterprise environment is required.
Demonstrated experience administering Jira projects, workflows, issue types, dashboards, filters, reports, custom fields, screens, permissions, schemes, notifications, data visualization, and Jira Automation and/or other workflow automation capabilities.
Experience with Jira Service Management, Jira Integrations or APIs.
Experience with qTest, GitHub, or other software development and testing tools.
Familiarity with scripting languages such as Python or JavaScript.
Experience working with Confluence and other Atlassian tools, such as Appfire Connector and zAgile.
Understanding of software development, QA, Agile, DevOps, release management and engineering delivery processes.
Ability to gather requirements, manage competing priorities, and work effectively with stakeholders at multiple levels of an organization.
Ability to work independently, take ownership of assigned responsibilities, and proactively identify opportunities for improvement.
Experience using AI-enabled tools to improve operational processes, reporting, automation, or data analysis.

What Forescout Offers You

Competitive compensation and benefits, including coverage of 85% of employee and dependent health care premiums, 100% company-paid employee life and disability insurance premiums, a 401(k) match, generous flexible time off for U.S. employees, voluntary life, accident, and critical illness insurance options, employee assistance program, maternity and parental bonding leave, and more.
A collaborative, innovative environment where you can help advance global security while working with leading technology.
Leadership teams that take ownership of team growth, actively supporting development, career progression, and opportunities for employees to do their best work.
Learn more @www.forescout.com .

Our Mission -
Continuously identify, protect, and ensure the compliance of all cyber assets across the modern organization.

Our Values

One Team– We all work together, and we all win together.
Cyber Obsessed– We are curious about technology, and we are innovative and passionate about solving big programs.
Customer Driven– We listen, we learn, and we make it right.
Relentless– We're smart, determined, and find a way. We figure stuff out.
Collaborative, without Ego– No one succeeds alone. We strive to be the humble person that people want to work with.

Thank you for taking the time to learn more about us. If this opportunity intrigues you, we encourage you to apply!

jobs.title: Senior Technical Program Manager, OEM Enablement
jobs.description:
At NVIDIA, we're at the forefront of innovation, redefining the future of computing with our powerful GPU technology. Our GPUs serve as the brains behind computers, robots, and self-driving cars, enabling them to understand and interact with their surroundings. NVIDIA is seeking a Senior Technical Program Manager on the Solutions Architecture team to help our OEM ecosystem and customers build, deploy, and support successful AI Factories. Academic and commercial groups worldwide use NVIDIA products to advance deep learning, data analytics, and accelerated computing. Join the team building many of the world's largest and fastest data centers and supercomputers!

You will work across OEM partners and NVIDIA teams to identify technical and ecosystem gaps and turn them into programs that improve customer outcomes. This role requires technical depth, adaptability, and an understanding of the end-to-end lifecycle of hardware systems in an AI Factory, from development and integration through deployment, operations, and support. You will work closely with engineering to solve problems while building relationships and influencing decisions across partner organizations and leadership teams. As products, customer needs, and the ecosystem evolve, you will help define where technical program leadership can have the greatest impact.

What You Will Be Doing

Lead technical programs across AI Factory development, deployment, and support, working with engineering and OEM partners to close readiness gaps and resolve dependencies as customer needs evolve.
Work across NVIDIA Solutions Architects (SAs), Field Application Engineers (FAEs), sales and account management, and engineering functions to align technical requirements, partner capabilities, and customer expectations.
Assess how OEM services and support capabilities meet CSP and NCP customer needs, and develop programs to close gaps. Areas may include technical training, engineering support, NVIDIA product knowledge and debugging, return material authorization (RMA), spares, and service readiness.
Engage OEM engineering, supply chain, and support teams to understand challenges, shape joint plans, and resolve technical issues with NVIDIA experts. Coordinate targeted training and knowledge transfer with SAs, FAEs, and engineering to strengthen OEM capabilities.
Engage OEM and NVIDIA leadership to frame opportunities, communicate technical and business implications, and influence decisions. Establish clear ownership and milestones; standardize templates, trackers, dashboards, and reviews for partner programs, deployment services, and leadership updates.
Use field operations data, customer and partner feedback, and engineering findings to improve partner workflows, deployment execution, and operating processes. Turn lessons learned into repeatable improvements in products, tooling, OEM training, and lifecycle support.

What We Need To See

Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related technical field, or equivalent experience.
12+ years of overall experience in enterprise and/or hyperscale data centers, hardware systems, or related infrastructure, with experience leading cross-functional technical programs.
Understand the hardware systems lifecycle—from development and validation through deployment and support—in large-scale AI infrastructure.
Technical depth to work closely with engineering on NVIDIA or similar AI systems, understand product architecture and system dependencies, and drive debugging and issue resolution with technical experts.
Bring structure to ambiguous problems, establish ownership and measurable outcomes, and adapt priorities as technologies and customer needs evolve.
Strong communication and relationship-building skills, with the ability to engage OEM engineering, supply chain, and support teams in detailed discussions and communicate program direction, tradeoffs, and decisions at the leadership level.
Demonstrated ability to influence outcomes and drive accountability without direct authority across engineering, customer-facing teams, and external partner organizations.
Willingness to travel (up to 25%).

Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd

Experience working directly with OEM/ODM partners and CSP or NCP customers on AI/HPC systems, infrastructure deployment, or lifecycle support.
Knowledge of NVIDIA products and AI Factory infrastructure, including accelerated computing, networking, and system-level debugging.
Experience building ecosystem capabilities or closing gaps across engineering enablement, service delivery, RMA, spares, or support, with demonstrated improvements to customer outcomes.

Your base salary will be determined based on your location, experience, and the pay of employees in similar positions. The base salary range is 200,000 USD - 322,000 USD.

You will also be eligible for equity and benefits.

Applications for this job will be accepted at least until October 31, 2026.

jobs.title: Technical Program Manager, Satellite
jobs.description:
Xona is the navigational intelligence company bringing real-time, centimeter-level certainty to any device, anywhere on Earth.

With Pulsar – the world’s most advanced PNT satellite infrastructure in Low Earth Orbit – Xona will offer a future-proof, backwards-compatible global positioning system optimized for absolute precision, superior power, and robust protection.

Role Overview

As Technical Program Manager, Satellite, you’ll support the execution of our satellite program across bus and payload, working closely with our program lead and engineering teams to keep a complex, fast-moving hardware program on track. You’ll own key program management workstreams, drive coordination across teams, and build deep familiarity with the hardware and development lifecycle.

You’ll have meaningful ownership, proximity to the hardware, and the opportunity to contribute to how program management operates as Xona scales. If you want to work closely with engineering teams, help drive a complex hardware program forward, and contribute to something genuinely new in space, this role is for you!

Responsibilities

Satellite Schedule Management: Maintain and drive the satellite development schedule across bus subsystems (power, GNC, structure) and payload (electrical, antennas, RF). Track progress against milestones, manage dependencies and critical-path items, and flag schedule risks early.
Cross-Functional Coordination: Coordinate across avionics, RF/payload, ground software, and production teams -- translating technical progress into shared plans, clear accountability, and actionable next steps.
Supplier & Partner Coordination: Work alongside the Supply Chain team and technical leads to track bus-vendor and payload-supplier deliverables, follow up on open items, and help keep external commitments synchronized with internal milestones.
Risk & Issue Resolution: Maintain the risk register and issue tracker, surface risks early, and work directly with technical leads to resolve blockers before they affect the schedule. Escalate material issues to the program lead with context, impact, and a recommended path forward.
Program Reporting: Prepare and deliver regular satellite program-status updates to leadership, maintaining a clear and accurate picture of schedule health, milestone progress, open risks, action items, and upcoming decisions.
Meeting & Action Management: Organize and facilitate program working sessions and cross-functional meetings; capture decisions and action items; and drive follow-through to closure.
Process Improvement: Help develop and improve lightweight, effective program-management processes suited to a small team moving quickly. Contribute ideas and practical improvements as the company scales.

Required Qualifications

3–5 years of experience in technical program management, project management, systems engineering, engineering operations, or a related role supporting complex hardware and/or software development.
Experience supporting a technical development program involving hardware, embedded software, systems integration, testing, manufacturing, and/or external suppliers.
Strong systems-thinking and organizational skills, with the ability to track interdependencies across mechanical, electrical, software, and integration workstreams while maintaining focus on the critical path.
Demonstrated ability to build and maintain schedules, track risks and action items, and communicate program health clearly.
Proactive and self-directed: you identify gaps, keep work moving, and know when to seek input or escalate.
Clear communicator who can work credibly with engineers and summarize status cleanly for leadership.
Comfortable operating in a fast-paced, evolving environment with lightweight processes and shifting priorities.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience supporting a satellite, spacecraft, launch-vehicle, aerospace, defense, robotics, telecommunications, or similarly complex hardware program.
Familiarity with satellite bus subsystems, RF communications, GNSS, PNT systems, navigation payloads, or mission operations.
Exposure to the hardware development lifecycle, including design reviews such as PDR/CDR, integration, test, manufacturing, and launch or operational readiness.
Experience coordinating deliverables with suppliers, vendors, or technical partners.
Proficiency with scheduling tools such as Wrike, MS Project, Smartsheet, Jira, or similar.
PMP, CAPM, Agile, or other PM certifications are nice to have, but not a substitute for practical program execution experience.

For U.S. Roles:
To comply with U.S. Government space technology export regulations, applicant must be a U.S. citizen, lawful permanent resident of the United States (i.e. Green Card holder), or other protected individual as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3).

For U.K. Roles:
To comply with U.K. regulations, this role requires Baseline Personnel Security Standard (BPSS) checks, and successful candidates must be eligible to obtain UK Security Clearance (SC).

For Canada Roles:
Successful candidates must obtain and hold a security clearance at the reliability status level, and pass security assessment for the Canadian Controlled Goods Program (CGP) and ITAR.
