jobs.title: Sr. Principal Technical Program Manager, End-to-End Data Center Delivery
jobs.description:
Job Description

Oracle Cloud Infrastructure is seeking a highly technical Senior Principal Technical Program Manager to lead end-to-end delivery of hyperscale data center capacity—from site strategy through customer-ready compute and GPU capacity, operational handover, and production go-live. This IC5-level leader owns the integrated delivery path across a complex portfolio of greenfield, expansion, and colocation programs. The role operates with broad autonomy, resolves high-impact technical and commercial tradeoffs, and aligns senior leaders and external partners around capacity commitments. Success requires deep fluency in mission-critical electrical systems, white-space infrastructure, structured cabling, fiber, network dependencies, commissioning, and operational readiness.

In this role you will provide strategic oversight and leadership for the construction of data centers by colocation providers, ensuring the completion of projects on time, within budget, and to the highest quality standards. Oversees the creation, review, and maintenance of documentation, including design review, commissioning, and problem-solving papers. Directs the implementation and oversight of quality control processes to ensure all construction activities meet design specifications and industry standards. Conducts strategic site walks and provides executive oversight and strategic leadership for the startup and commissioning phases of major data center projects. Identifies critical gaps in risk identification and mitigation and drives organizational-wide initiatives to address these gaps. Leads the role of primary point of contact between the company and colocation providers. Oversees the selection, negotiation, and management of contracts with external vendors, contractors, and suppliers, ensuring contract compliance and performance and construction activities align with the approved design plans and specifications. Oversees the installation of power, cooling, networking, and structured cabling systems.

Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

Lead multiple complex, high-value hyperscale data center capacity-delivery programs from site selection and due diligence through construction, commissioning, infrastructure deployment, and customer go-live.

Own the integrated master schedule, capacity milestones, budget, risk and issue management, change control, recovery planning, and executive reporting.
Define and drive the cross-functional delivery strategy across Real Estate, Capacity Planning, Energy and Utilities, Design Engineering, Procurement, Construction, Network, Security, Infrastructure Deployment, Finance, and Data Center Operations.
Lead technical due diligence for prospective sites and colocation facilities, assessing utility availability, power-delivery timelines, fiber connectivity, permitting, constructability, physical constraints, and readiness to support forecasted compute and GPU demand.
Drive technical decisions and execution across critical electrical and low-voltage scope, including utility interconnects, medium- and low-voltage distribution, switchgear, generators, UPS, busway, RPPs, containment, structured cabling, fiber pathways, network rooms, and white-space fit-out.
Establish and govern technical design reviews, constructability reviews, submittals, acceptance criteria, and decision forums; identify and resolve cross-functional dependencies before they affect committed capacity dates.
Direct readiness of critical equipment, construction progress, commissioning, integrated systems testing, quality validation, punch-list closure, and final acceptance.
Ensure network, fiber, security, low-voltage, and server-deployment workstreams are sequenced and ready to safely energize, validate, and make capacity available to customers.
Manage strategic relationships and delivery interfaces with general contractors, design firms, equipment vendors, colocation providers, utilities, carriers, and other external partners.
Lead escalation and resolution of complex technical, schedule, commercial, and operational risks that span multiple organizations or programs.
Drive operational handover to Data Center Operations, including asset and configuration data, maintenance information, test results, warranties, training, documentation, residual-risk management, and ownership transition.
Establish repeatable delivery mechanisms, metrics, technical standards, and lessons learned that improve predictability, speed, cost, and quality across the regional data center portfolio.
Communicate clearly and credibly with technical teams and executive stakeholders on capacity commitments, schedule health, cost exposure, key decisions, risks, and recovery actions.

Required Qualifications

8+ years of experience in technical program management, project delivery, engineering, construction, infrastructure deployment, or operations within mission-critical environments.
5+ years of direct experience delivering hyperscale, cloud, colocation, or large-scale enterprise data center programs.
Demonstrated ownership of complex programs spanning early planning, design, construction, commissioning, technical fit-out, infrastructure deployment, and operational handover.
Deep working knowledge of critical electrical infrastructure, including utility interfaces, substations or switchgear, generators, UPS systems, electrical distribution, busway, RPPs, and data-hall power distribution.
Strong technical understanding of low-voltage and network infrastructure, including structured cabling, fiber systems, containment, pathways, network deployment dependencies, and security-system interfaces.
Experience managing integrated schedules, critical paths, budgets, scope changes, vendor performance, commercial risk, and executive-level communications.
Proven ability to influence senior stakeholders, lead through ambiguity, make sound technical tradeoffs, and resolve issues across organizational boundaries.
Ability to travel up to 50% within the Eastern U.S., particularly across Northern Virginia/IAD.

Preferred Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Electrical, Mechanical, Civil, or Construction Engineering; Construction Management; or a related technical discipline.
Experience delivering high-density AI, GPU, HPC, or large-scale cloud capacity.
Experience with both greenfield and leased/colocation data center delivery models.
Expertise in commissioning, integrated systems testing, operational readiness, and customer capacity turn-up.
Experience leading regional portfolios or programs with multiple concurrent data center delivery workstreams.
Proficiency with Primavera P6, Microsoft Project, Smartsheet, Jira, SharePoint, or comparable delivery-management tools.
PMP, PgMP, CDCP, CDCS, or related mission-critical infrastructure certification.

Qualifications

Medical, dental, and vision insurance, including expert medical opinion
Short term disability and long term disability
Life insurance and AD&D
Supplemental life insurance (Employee/Spouse/Child)
Health care and dependent care Flexible Spending Accounts
Pre-tax commuter and parking benefits
401(k) Savings and Investment Plan with company match
Paid time off: Flexible Vacation is provided to all eligible employees assigned to a salaried (non-overtime eligible) position. Accrued Vacation is provided to all other employees eligible for vacation benefits. For employees working at least 35 hours per week, the vacation accrual rate is 13 days annually for the first three years of employment and 18 days annually for subsequent years of employment. Vacation accrual is prorated for employees working between 20 and 34 hours per week. Employees working fewer than 20 hours per week are not eligible for vacation.
11 paid holidays

26WD101205, Technical Program Manager , AI/ML

Position Overview

The Platform Services and Emerging Technologies (PSET) team is seeking a Technical Program Manager (TPM) to drive successful delivery of Autodesk's Generative AI Accelerator (GAIA) outcomes.

In this role, you will drive complex, cross-functional programs that move emerging AI capabilities from research into production. You will partner closely with research, engineering, architecture, data, security, legal, and product leadership so that new AI capabilities are delivered responsibly, predictably, and at scale.

This role requires strong technical depth including AI fluency, excellent execution discipline, and the ability to operate effectively across organizations to align priorities, manage risk, and drive outcomes in ambiguous, fast-moving environments.

Responsibilities

Drive end-to-end delivery of GAIA program outcomes, from experimentation through production readiness and adoption
Drive the business outcomes realized through delivery of AI/ML capabilities, partnering with engineering teams and leadership across product integration, platform adoption, and operational scalability
Build and maintain integrated delivery plans across research and engineering teams, ensuring clear milestones, dependencies, and risk management
Drive delivery forecasting, execution tracking, and transparent reporting across program lifecycles
Orchestrate delivery across research, engineering, security, legal, product, and platform teams, following changes downstream to everything they touch
Partner with executive stakeholders, architects, and product leaders to shape strategy, sequencing, and execution plans
Provide clear, actionable status reporting at both executive and team levels, including risks, tradeoffs, and mitigation strategies
Anticipate dependencies and risks rather than discover them, across data, model readiness, and delivery timelines
Support teams with impediment removal, exception handling, and dependency resolution
Use approved AI tools and automation responsibly to create visibility, repeatability, and a single source of truth across delivery, while validating outputs and maintaining human judgment
Champion Agile and Lean delivery practices, supporting self-organizing teams operating in complex environments
Use evidence and validated learning to adapt plans, improving delivery effectiveness, collaboration, and program outcomes
Act as a change agent, helping teams navigate evolving requirements, research uncertainty, and platform priorities

Minimum Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Business Administration, or a related field
5+ years of experience delivering complex, cross-team initiatives in fast-paced technical environments
3+ years in a TPM, Product Manager, Software Architect, or similar role
Strong understanding of cloud platforms and distributed systems, including APIs and services on AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud
Working knowledge of AI/ML concepts and the software development lifecycle, including how AI-assisted tools are used in delivery
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence across technical and non-technical audiences
Strong problem-solving skills with a bias toward action and outcomes

Preferred Qualifications

Experience delivering AI/ML, Generative AI, data platform, or research-to-production programs
Familiarity with AI systems such as model training and evaluation, inference and serving, or retrieval and vector databases
Understanding of Responsible AI, data governance, privacy, and compliance concepts
Passion for operational excellence, process improvement, and scalable delivery practices

26WD101205 Responsable de programme technique, IA/ML

Aperçu du Poste

L'équipe « Platform Services and Emerging Technologies » (PSET) recherche un responsable de programme technique (TPM) chargé de piloter la mise en œuvre réussie des résultats du programme « Generative AI Accelerator » (GAIA) d'Autodesk.

À ce poste, vous piloterez des programmes complexes et transversaux visant à faire passer les capacités émergentes en IA de la recherche à la production. Vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec les responsables de la recherche, de l’ingénierie, de l’architecture, des données, de la sécurité, des affaires juridiques et des produits afin de garantir que les nouvelles capacités d’IA soient mises en œuvre de manière responsable, prévisible et à grande échelle.

Ce poste exige de solides connaissances techniques, notamment une maîtrise approfondie de l’IA, une excellente discipline d’exécution et la capacité à intervenir efficacement au sein de différentes structures organisationnelles pour aligner les priorités, gérer les risques et obtenir des résultats dans des environnements ambigus et en constante évolution.

Responsabilités

Piloter la mise en œuvre de bout en bout des résultats du programme GAIA, de l’expérimentation à la mise en production et à l’adoption
Piloter les résultats commerciaux obtenus grâce à la mise en œuvre des capacités d’IA/ML, en partenariat avec les équipes d’ingénierie et les responsables dans les domaines de l’intégration des produits, de l’adoption de la plateforme et de l’évolutivité opérationnelle
Élaborer et maintenir des plans de mise en œuvre intégrés entre les équipes de recherche et d’ingénierie, en garantissant la clarté des jalons, des dépendances et de la gestion des risques
Piloter les prévisions de mise en œuvre, le suivi de l’exécution et le reporting transparent tout au long du cycle de vie des programmes
Orchestrer la mise en œuvre entre les équipes de recherche, d’ingénierie, de sécurité, juridiques, produit et de plateforme, en suivant les répercussions en aval sur tout ce qu’elles touchent
Collaborer avec les parties prenantes de la direction, les architectes et les responsables produit pour définir la stratégie, l’enchaînement des étapes et les plans d’exécution
Fournir des rapports d’état clairs et exploitables tant au niveau de la direction qu’au niveau des équipes, incluant les risques, les compromis et les stratégies d’atténuation
Anticiper les dépendances et les risques plutôt que de les découvrir a posteriori, qu’il s’agisse des données, de l’état de préparation des modèles ou des délais de mise en œuvre
Soutenir les équipes en éliminant les obstacles, en gérant les exceptions et en résolvant les dépendances
Utiliser de manière responsable les outils d’IA et d’automatisation approuvés pour garantir la visibilité, la reproductibilité et une source unique de vérité tout au long de la livraison, tout en validant les résultats et en préservant le jugement humain
Promouvoir les pratiques de livraison Agile et Lean, en soutenant les équipes auto-organisées évoluant dans des environnements complexes
S’appuyer sur des données factuelles et des enseignements validés pour adapter les plans, améliorant ainsi l’efficacité de la livraison, la collaboration et les résultats du programme
Agir en tant qu’agent du changement, en aidant les équipes à s’adapter à l’évolution des exigences, aux incertitudes liées à la recherche et aux priorités de la plateforme

Qualifications Minimales

Licence en ingénierie, en informatique, en gestion d’entreprise ou dans un domaine connexe
Au moins 5 ans d’expérience dans la mise en œuvre d’initiatives complexes impliquant plusieurs équipes, au sein d’environnements techniques en constante évolution
Au moins 3 ans d’expérience dans un poste de TPM, de chef de produit, d’architecte logiciel ou dans un rôle similaire
Solide compréhension des plateformes cloud et des systèmes distribués, y compris les API et les services sur AWS, Azure ou Google Cloud
Connaissance pratique des concepts d’IA/ML et du cycle de vie du développement logiciel, notamment de l’utilisation des outils assistés par l’IA dans la mise en œuvre
Excellentes compétences en communication et en gestion des parties prenantes, avec la capacité d’influencer des publics tant techniques que non techniques
Solides compétences en résolution de problèmes, avec une orientation vers l’action et les résultats

Qualifications Souhaitées

Expérience dans la mise en œuvre de programmes d’IA/ML, d’IA générative, de plateformes de données ou de programmes allant de la recherche à la production
Connaissance des systèmes d’IA tels que l’entraînement et l’évaluation de modèles, l’inférence et le service, ou encore les bases de données de recherche et vectorielles
Compréhension des concepts de responsabilité en matière d’IA, de gouvernance des données, de confidentialité et de conformité

jobs.title: Senior Technical Program Manager, ECU Reliability & Durability Validation
jobs.description:
About Us

Rivian and Volkswagen Group Technologies is a joint venture between two industry leaders with a clear vision for automotive’s next chapter. From operating systems to zonal controllers to cloud and connectivity solutions, we’re addressing the challenges of electric vehicles through technology that will set the standards for software-defined vehicles around the world.

The road to the future is uncharted. By combining our expertise across connectivity, AI, security and more, we’ll map a new way forward. Working together, we’ll create a future that’s more connected, more intelligent, more sustainable for everyone.

Role Summary

As RVT’s ECU portfolio scales across vehicle platforms and brand partner programs, the rigor and speed of our reliability and durability validation programs have never been more critical. Our Electrical Hardware Technical Program Management team is seeking a Senior Technical Program Manager to own the planning, coordination, and execution of R&D validation programs for our ECU product line—ensuring every unit we ship meets the environmental, mechanical, and life-cycle demands of the world’s most demanding automotive applications.

In this role, you will be the connective tissue between test engineers, hardware design teams, internal labs, and third-party test facilities. You will translate program milestones into actionable test schedules, track execution against those plans, surface risks early, and drive issues to closure—all while maintaining clear visibility for stakeholders across the organization.

Your primary domain is reliability and durability: thermal cycling, vibration, shock, humidity, HALT, and accelerated life testing across ECU hardware spanning high-compute Infotainment, Connectivity, and Zonal controllers.

This role requires strong program management instincts, a hands-on technical foundation in hardware validation, and the organizational influence to drive complex, multi-team test programs to successful completion.

Responsibilities

Own and maintain reliability and durability validation program schedules; align test milestones with ECU and vehicle-level program gates across all xVT maturity phases.
Coordinate test execution across RVT’s internal labs in Northern and Southern California and accredited third-party test facilities; manage capacity, sample allocation, and sequencing.
Develop and maintain the R&D validation test plan (DVP&R) for assigned ECU programs, ensuring coverage of thermal cycling, vibration, shock, humidity, corrosion, and accelerated life testing.
Identify, escalate, and actively drive mitigation of program risks related to test schedule, lab availability, sample readiness, and failure closure.
Support test readiness reviews with ECU TPMs, confirming that R&D test infrastructure, samples, and procedures are in place ahead of each program gate.
Author and maintain test coordination artifacts: program trackers, status reports, risk registers, and gate review packages for internal and partner audiences.
Drive continuous improvement of R&D test planning processes, coordination workflows, and reporting practices across the ECU validation team.

Qualifications

Minimum Qualifications:

4+ years of experience in technical program management, test engineering, or validation coordination in the automotive, aerospace, or consumer electronics industry.
B.S. or M.S. in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Systems Engineering, or related technical field.
Hands-on familiarity with ECU / PCBA reliability and durability test methods: thermal cycling, vibration (random & sine), mechanical shock, humidity, corrosion, and HALT.
Experience developing and maintaining DVP&R documents and reliability test plans aligned to automotive standards (ISO 16750, AEC-Q, IEC 60068, or OEM-specific test specs).
Demonstrated ability to manage complex, multi-workstream validation programs—tracking milestones, samples, lab capacity, and cross-team dependencies simultaneously.
Experience coordinating with both internal test labs and accredited third-party test facilities, including scheduling, sample management, and report review.
Strong written and verbal communication skills; able to produce clear status reports, risk registers, and gate review packages for engineering and program leadership.
Experience with Atlassian-based tools including Jira and Confluence for program tracking, documentation, and cross-team coordination.
Ability to travel domestically and internationally to test laboratories, supplier sites, and vehicle program locations as needed.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with EV ECU hardware—Infotainment, Connectivity, BMS, or Zonal controllers—and the unique reliability and environmental requirements of electrified vehicle platforms.

Total Rewards

We build the exceptional — and we believe the people doing that work should be rewarded accordingly. In addition to a competitive base salary, full-time positions may be is eligible to participate in our annual company performance bonus program.

Payments are discretionary and not guaranteed; actual amounts depend on company results and the terms of the plan in effect, and require active employment at the time of payout. This role is also eligible for equity in the form of Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), subject to board approval and the terms of our equity incentive plans, including applicable vesting requirements.

In addition to our compensation programs, we invest in our people with a comprehensive benefits package designed to support the health, wellbeing, and financial future for full-time employees — including health coverage, retirement savings, time off, and family planning programs. Offerings vary by country. Learn more about our global benefit programs
.

External candidates can apply for this role through the Rivian and Volkswagen Group Technologies careers site ( https://rivianvw.tech/#careers
). If you are a current employee, please apply through our internal job board
.

Equal Opportunity

Rivian and Volkswagen Group Technologies is committed to creating a diverse environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, ancestry, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender expression, gender identity, genetic information or characteristics, physical or mental disability, marital/domestic partner status, age, military/veteran status, medical condition, or any other characteristic protected by law. We are also committed to ensuring compliance with all applicable fair employment practice laws regarding citizenship and immigration status.

Rivian and Volkswagen Group Technologies is committed to ensuring that our hiring process is accessible for persons with disabilities. If you have a disability or limitation, such as those covered by the Americans with Disabilities Act, that requires accommodations to assist you in the search and application process, please email us at candidateaccommodations@rivian.com.

Candidate Data Privacy

Rivian and Volkswagen Group Technologies” may collect, use and disclose your personal information or personal data (within the meaning of the applicable data protection laws) when you apply for employment and/or participate in our recruitment processes (“Candidate Personal Data”). This data includes contact, demographic, communications, educational, professional, employment, social media/website, network/device, recruiting system usage/interaction, security and preference information. Rivian and Volkswagen Group Technologies may use your Candidate Personal Data for the purposes of (i) tracking interactions with our recruiting system; (ii) carrying out, analyzing and improving our application and recruitment process, including assessing you and your application and conducting employment, background and reference checks; (iii) establishing an employment relationship or entering into an employment contract with you; (iv) complying with our legal, regulatory and corporate governance obligations; (v) record keeping; (vi) ensuring network and information security and preventing fraud; and (vii) as otherwise required or permitted by applicable law.

Rivian and Volkswagen Group Technologies may share your Candidate Personal Data with (i) internal personnel who have a need to know such information in order to perform their duties, including individuals on our People Team, Finance, Legal, and the team(s) with the position(s) for which you are applying; (ii) Rivian and Volkswagen Group Technologies affiliates; and (iii) Rivian and Volkswagen Group Technologies’ service providers, including providers of background checks, staffing services, and cloud services.

Rivian and Volkswagen Group Technologies may transfer or store internationally your Candidate Personal Data, including to or in the United States, Canada, and the European Union and in the cloud, and this data may be subject to the laws and accessible to the courts, law enforcement and national security authorities of such jurisdictions.

If you provide a mobile telephone number as part of your application or during the recruitment process, Rivian and Volkswagen Group Technologies may use that number to contact you via SMS text message for recruitment-related purposes, including scheduling, logistics, and status updates. Message and data rates may apply. You may opt out of SMS communications at any time by replying STOP to any text message you receive from us. jobs.title: Senior Program Manager, Test Automation
jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

About The Team

The Test Automation Engineering team develops test systems used to ensure the quality and reliability of Anduril’s products. The team works on complex manufacturing test solutions for our internal manufacturing team and deploys out to contract manufacturers. We work closely and cross-functionally with the rest of our Product Engineering groups that include Electrical, Mechanical and Firmware Engineering to solve and improve our manufacturing processes, product quality and reliability.

About The Job

In this position, you will own large parts of the end-to-end test system development - enhancing transparency and generating actional reports to support strategic and tactical decision making. You’ll support increasing efficiencies throughout our end-to-end processes, all with a focus on introducing scale and resiliency into our growing people and tools footprint. If you thrive in fast-paced, technical environments and excel at juggling multiple responsibilities, we want to hear from you.

We’re looking for a Senior Program Manager to own the planning, execution, and delivery of tester solutions in the Hardware Engineering Services Department. You’ll be an ally collaborating with our partner Programs, working directly with other Program Managers, Engineering Leads, Internal/External Manufacturing, Supply Chain and Logistics.

What You'll Do

Responsible for successful program execution, exceeding both internal and external stakeholder expectations and meeting all contractual commitments
Demonstrate collaborative leadership skills by building trust with your teams, customers, and peers while holding yourself and the cross functional team accountable to execute on business outcomes
Communicate effectively and with confidence when engaging with customers and Anduril leadership
Manage the overall program schedule from kickoff planning to tester deployment, including critical path tracking, schedule risk mitigations, visibility to Anduril leadership and updates to the customer
Navigate customer change requests while maintaining program velocity and adhering to financial targets through scope management and change control
Ensure decisions support current efforts and position the company for continued hardware engineering services growth
Support Test Automation leadership in preparation and management of critical technical and business forums
Provide structure to ambiguity and help drive production stakeholders towards decisions on tactical and strategic issues
Execute creative solutions on short timelines to get answers quickly, while also considering more scalable solutions that will make Anduril successful in the long term
Analyze test program metrics to identify trends, patterns, and areas for improvement of test product processes.

Required Qualifications

5+ years experience managing the development of technical systems throughout the product lifecycle
Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Business Administration, or a related field (technical background preferred)
Proven track record of managing medium to large-scale, complex programs across the product development lifecycle
Demonstrated ability to create and execute a complex program schedule
Demonstrated ability to actively develop and execute an effective program risk management plan
Experience in developing and executing communication strategies for high-visibility programs
Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills
Experience coordinating multiple internal and external teams within a complex engineering or technology-focused organization
Willingness to travel as needed (up to 15%)
Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Business Administration, or a related field
Eligible to obtain and maintain an active U.S. Top Secret SCI security clearance.

US Salary Range

$147,000—$220,000 USD

Benefits

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. For more information, Explore Our Benefits.

Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To Ensure Your Safety And Help You Navigate Your Job Search With Confidence, Please Keep The Following Critical Points In Mind

No Financial Requests: Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.
Please always verify communications:
Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an @anduril.com address.
Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com.

Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach: If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.
What to Do If You Suspect Fraud: Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to contact@anduril.com. Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts.

Data Privacy

To view Anduril's candidate data privacy policy, please visit https://anduril.com/applicant-privacy-notice/.

By submitting your application, you consent to Anduril Industries using a third-party service provider to conduct pre-employment risk, integrity, and due diligence screening and assessing potential risks as part of your application process. This third-party service provider provides risk-intelligence services that may include analysis of sanctions and watchlists, adverse media, public-record information, and other lawful open-source or commercial data sources. This third-party service provider does not act as a consumer reporting agency. Use of this provider helps to ensure compliance with applicable laws and protect technology, intellectual property, and organizational security.

jobs.title: Principal Business Program Manager (Engineering & Project Management)
jobs.description:
Who We Are

We're powering a cleaner, brighter future.

Exelon is leading the energy transformation, and we're calling all problem solvers, innovators, community builders and change makers. Work with us to deliver solutions that make our diverse cities and communities stronger, healthier and more resilient.

We're powered by purpose-driven people like you who believe in being inclusive and creative, and value safety, innovation, integrity and community service. We are a Fortune 200 company, 20,000 colleagues strong serving more than 10.7 million customers at six energy companies -- Atlantic City Electric (ACE), Baltimore Gas and Electric (BGE), Commonwealth Edison (ComEd), Delmarva Power & Light (DPL), PECO Energy Company (PECO), and Potomac Electric Power Company (Pepco).

We're committed to creating an environment where every person can thrive. Our employee experience is grounded in four tenets that guide how we support our people: purposeful careers, growth opportunities, community impact, and support to thrive.

In our relentless pursuit of excellence, we elevate diverse voices, fresh perspectives and bold thinking. And since we know transforming the future of energy is hard work, we provide competitive compensation, incentives, excellent benefits and the opportunity to build a rewarding career.

Are you in?

Primary Purpose

Develop, manage, and evaluate high profile, complex projects/programs/initiatives involving multiple organizations from engineering, planning, design scope build out to post implementation phases as required. Develop business plans, project charters and performance metrics in support of business objectives. Ensure organizational alignment with management models and principles and drive the integration of best practices. Track and report progress on key business initiatives. Manage quality assurance and/or change management activities involving internal and external personnel. This position will maintain an on-going interface with various Exelon organizations in areas such as the execution of business processes, strategic initiatives, and management model implementation. Position may be required to work extended hours for coverage during storms or other energy delivery emergencies.

Primary Duties

Direct development and lead teams on strategic business initiatives, projects, and programs. Lead requirements analysis, performance measurement, and/or quality assurance. Manage scope, schedule, and budget for strategic high profile, complex organizational projects and programs.
Manage and report on process/project/initiative assignments. Develop performance indicators and tracking mechanisms to monitor and report results. Oversee, prepare, review, and analyze reports and controls for strategic projects and initiatives.
Develop work plans to implement corrective actions that are identified as a result of performance assessment.
Oversee the establishment of business plans and objectives across multiple areas / departments. Lead stakeholders in the development of business cases and prioritization of deliverables.
Lead change management activities for projects, programs, and initiatives. Develop and implement training of employees and external personnel for new processes and procedures. Develop and implement effective business readiness procedures.
Drive the integration of best practices within the organization. Investigate best practices through benchmarking and develop and execute work plans to support the integration of the functions and best practices identified. Maintain on-going interface with various Exelon organizations regarding the execution of business processes, strategic initiatives, and management model.

Job Scope

This is an individual contributor position that works independently with little or no supervision. The position requires integration of business knowledge and functional priorities to address complex problems and non-standard situations. The position regularly mentors less experienced colleagues.
Financial Scope: Direct impact on budget is substantial
This position has a direct impact on the Company's performance regarding several key indicators, operational costs, System Average Interruption Frequency Index (SAIFI), Customer Average Interruption Duration Index (CAIDI) and Customer Satisfaction by managing scope, budget and schedule to within approved parameters, and providing structured and detailed reports to the appropriate Management team. Drives the development of strategic and reliability projects/programs/initiatives to ensure complete and successful implementation. Develops and tracks key milestones. Cost of failure would have a significant impact on Exelon reliability and financial goals.

jobs.title: Senior Project Manager
jobs.description:
About FX Digital

FX Digital is a specialist Connected TV agency, providing a wide range of services, including Product Strategy, Design, Engineering, and Test Automation. We partner with global streaming brands such as Discovery+, BritBox, ATP Media, ITV, and Dyn.

Role Summary

Owns end-to-end delivery on complex or multi-workstream projects: planning, RAID, budgets, forecasting, margin and change control, anticipating risk before it's raised. Leads cross-functional project teams, including TAs, Product Managers, Designers, Engineers and QAs. A trusted senior contact who builds strong client relationships, leads difficult conversations unsupported and keeps senior stakeholders informed proactively.

Brings solutions rather than problems, introduces new practices and tools, and formally mentors and/or manages junior colleagues, building a psychologically safe, accountable team environment on their projects.

What You'll Do

Delivery Performance

Planning - build integrated plans across workstreams, manage the cross-workstream critical path, and model scenarios to support decisions.
Risk & RAID - anticipate systemic risk across workstreams and drive mitigation across teams; keep RAID decision-ready, so it's used as the source of truth in client and leadership reviews.
Change control - run change control across your projects, taking every CR through approval.
Agile & continuous delivery - tailor the agile approach across workstreams; use delivery metrics to forecast and spot risk early.
Releases - work with Engineering to move projects towards continuous delivery (feature flags, automated release gates, frequent small releases), balanced against client approval and CTV platform certification.
Product Owner role - act as Product Owner on smaller, less complex projects with no dedicated Product Manager, owning the backlog, prioritisation and acceptance criteria; judge when a dedicated Product Manager is needed instead.
Delivery KPIs - keep schedule and cost variance, RAG-red weeks and project lifecycle sign-offs on track against department targets across complex portfolios.

Financial Performance

Budgets, forecasting & margin - own budgets, forecasting and margin across larger or concurrent projects, protecting margin proactively.
Cadence - monitor weekly, re-forecast at least fortnightly, and flag any margin variance across all your projects.
CR estimates - estimate change requests with the team before any commitment is made to the client.
Time & overtime - track time accurately and follow the overtime request process where applicable.
Forecast accuracy - keep forecast accuracy at or above the department KPIs.

Client Experience

Client relationship management - act as the trusted senior contact for client stakeholders, building trust-based relationships and leading difficult conversations and negotiations unsupported.
Status communication - keep client and internal senior stakeholders informed with proactive, consistent status updates across workstreams.
Issue & defect communication - communicate issues, defects and bugs proactively, factually and promptly, including unwelcome news to senior stakeholders, always with options.
Technical translation - frame technical trade-offs for senior or executive stakeholders, and challenge technical recommendations that don't serve the client outcome.
Client feedback - seek regular client feedback across your projects and act on it, keeping client satisfaction at or above the department target and adopting a ‘yes, but' approach where required.

Operational Excellence

Tools & reporting - champion best practice across the team's tools.
Innovation & continuous improvement - introduce new practices and tools on your projects, measure the results and share them; drive process improvement beyond your own projects.
AI & new tools - lead adoption of FX-approved AI and automation tools across your workstreams, within FX tooling and client data policies.

Leadership & Collaboration

Team leadership & mentoring - formally mentor and/or manage junior colleagues and set the team culture on your projects, building a psychologically safe, accountable environment.
Stakeholder management - resolve competing priorities between senior client and internal stakeholders without escalation (e.g. launch date vs stability, extra scope vs budget).
Account growth - actively shape and pitch expansion opportunities, starting from what the client is trying to achieve.
Impact assessments - own impact assessments for new or expanded scope, including delivery approach, risk and resourcing, and present them to the Commercial Team and client where applicable.

What You Bring

Judgement under pressure - consistently acts as a Project Leader, not a coordinator: anticipates problems before they land, brings solutions and a recommendation, makes the call on difficult trade-offs, and stays composed under pressure.
Ownership - anticipates slippage; holds team and self to the same standard.
Strategic thinking - shapes delivery approach and planning decisions; anticipates future account needs.
Communication - reads senior and executive audiences and adapts the message in the moment.
Candour - delivers unwelcome news to senior stakeholders, with options.
Innovation mindset - actively looks for new practices and technology that improve delivery, and tests them rather than waiting for others to.
Learning - shares what they learn across the department.
Collaboration - creates an environment where mistakes are raised without blame.
Influence - influences without authority across disciplines and senior stakeholders.

Experience

5-8 years leading complex or concurrent delivery, with demonstrated mentoring and/or management of other PMs, or equivalent demonstrated capability.

Desirable

Experience in a digital agency, ideally delivering apps or streaming products for multiple clients.
Exposure to OTT/CTV, streaming, or broader digital product delivery.
Experience building or improving a delivery process or templates that the department went on to adopt.
Experience leading adoption of AI or new tooling within a delivery team.

Why work at FX?

To recognise everyone's incredible contribution to the success of the business, we offer an annual profit share
Personal development is hugely important, so we invest time for you to up-skill, learn and grow
Pension contributions with Scottish Widows
Vitality health insurance*
Cycle-to-work scheme*
35 days of annual leave, including bank holidays and Christmas office shutdown
Early finish Fridays in the summer
Flexible working - with the option to work 2 days a week from home
We appreciate that the world has changed and so we also offer a flexi start time between 9am and 10am
To ensure that our remote workers don't miss out on the office experience, we have invested in technology that allows us to run company events in a hybrid way
Every month you have the option of a one-on-one Sanctus mental health coaching session, a great opportunity to get quality mental health support at work
Take part in regular company-wide and team-specific socials (both in-person and remote)
We take great pride in our culture of acceptance, diversity and inclusion
Complete regular surveys to provide anonymous feedback on the business, leadership team and your role to ensure that we are doing everything we can to keep improving and making FX a great place to work
Join us at our monthly Show and Tell, where team members update us on what they've been working on
Get nominated for the monthly FX Factor by your peers and get recognised for your contribution to the business
We are invested in your growth and so we run regular appraisals, to ensure you are receiving constant feedback and working towards goals for growth
We support our team to get involved in conferences, events and trade shows at home and abroad
Work with epic and prestigious global brands in the media, sport and entertainment space, from Discovery to BBC and ATP Media

If you're passionate about this role and believe you can add value, we encourage you to apply, even if your background doesn't match the job description exactly.

This is a full-time role based out of our office in Old Street, London. We can only consider applicants who are able to work 3 days per week from the office.

Upon completion of a 6 month probationary period

jobs.title: Program Security Manager
jobs.description:
Umbra is an American space technology company delivering advanced systems, from sensors to spacecraft, that empower customers worldwide with unmatched access to critical information from space. Our mission is simple and ambitious: redefine space—for people, systems, and missions in every domain. Umbra's ecosystem operates through three business units: Remote Sensing (the data), Space Systems (the components), and Mission Solutions (the platforms). Together, our teams develop capabilities that deliver persistent access, resilient performance, and mission-ready solutions, advancing U.S. space leadership while keeping the world safe and informed.

About The Job

The Program Security Manager
is responsible for leading and managing security requirements for complex programs supporting the U.S. Intelligence Community. This position serves as the primary security advisor to program leadership and ensures personnel, physical, information, industrial, operational, and cybersecurity activities are integrated throughout the program lifecycle.

The Program Security Manager will work closely with government security representatives, Program Management, Engineering, Information Security, Industrial Security, Facilities, and external partners to protect classified information, sensitive technologies, facilities, systems, and mission operations. The successful candidate must have demonstrated experience independently managing complex Intelligence Community security programs and translating government security requirements into practical operational controls.

This position is based on-site in our Reston, VA office.

Key Responsibilities

Lead the development, implementation, and administration of integrated security programs supporting classified Intelligence Community activities.
Serve as the primary security liaison among program leadership, government security representatives, customers, subcontractors, and internal security organizations.
Interpret and implement Intelligence Community directives, contract security requirements, classification guidance, and customer-specific security policies.
Develop and maintain program security plans, standard operating procedures, classification guides, training materials, and other security documentation.
Manage personnel security requirements, including clearance verification, access eligibility, indoctrinations, debriefings, visit certifications, and need-to-know determinations.
Coordinate physical, technical, and information systems security requirements for classified facilities, mission environments, and accredited systems, partnering with ISSOs to support ICD 503, RMF, and continuous monitoring activities.
Manage the classification, safeguarding, handling, transmission, reproduction, destruction, and authorized release of classified and sensitive information.
Develop and oversee OPSEC, COMSEC, Counterintelligence, Insider Threat, and Security Awareness activities, as applicable.
Conduct security risk assessments and evaluate system architectures, operational concepts, and supply-chain decisions to ensure compliance and inform program protection strategies.
Investigate and report security incidents, violations, and potential compromises, and drive corrective actions to closure.
Conduct internal inspections and readiness assessments, and support government audits, reviews, and compliance evaluations.
Integrate security requirements into program schedules, budgets, proposals, contracts, and subcontractor activities.
Provide security guidance and briefings to executives, program personnel, engineers, and external partners.
Maintain security records, metrics, risk registers, and executive-level reporting.
Support program startup, facility activation, system deployment, operational transitions, and program closeout activities.

Requirements

Required Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in security management, intelligence studies, criminal justice, cybersecurity, engineering, business, or a related field; equivalent professional experience may be considered.
5-8+ years of progressively responsible security experience, including direct experience supporting classified Intelligence Community programs.
Active TS/SCI security clearance.
Demonstrated experience independently managing complex, multidisciplinary security programs involving multiple organizations, facilities, systems, classification levels, or security compartments.
Strong working knowledge of Intelligence Community security policies and frameworks, including ICD 503 and ICD 705.
Experience implementing personnel, physical, information, industrial, and operational security requirements within IC classified environments.
Experience working directly with government security representatives and Intelligence Community customers.
Working knowledge of the National Industrial Security Program Operating Manual, 32 CFR Part 117, and applicable federal security requirements.
Experience preparing for and supporting government security inspections, facility accreditations, system authorization activities, and compliance assessments.
Demonstrated ability to assess risk, interpret complex security requirements, and develop practical solutions that support mission execution.
Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to brief senior leadership and communicate effectively with technical and nontechnical stakeholders.
Ability to obtain and maintain customer-specific accesses, polygraph requirements, and additional security approvals, as required.

Desired Qualifications

10+ years of security experience supporting Intelligence Community, Department of War, space, aerospace, or national-security programs.
Experience serving as a Program Security Officer, Contractor Special Security Officer, Facility Security Officer, or comparable senior security representative directly in space organizations (NRO/NGA).
Ability to manage competing priorities and make sound security decisions in a fast-paced, mission-focused environment.
Experience supporting compartmented, Special Access Program, or multi-domain mission environments.
Experience with program protection, supply-chain risk management, counterintelligence, threat assessments, or technology-protection activities.
Experience establishing or accrediting SCIFs and supporting classified information-system authorization.
Familiarity with NIST SP 800-53, the Risk Management Framework, Committee on National Security Systems requirements, and applicable Intelligence Community overlays.
Professional certifications such as ISP, CPP, PSP, CISSP, Security+, or equivalent government security training.

Benefits

Flexible Time Off, Sick, Family & Medical Leave
Medical, Dental, Vision, Life, LTD, STD (employer funded)
Vol Life, Critical Illness, Accidental, Hospital Indemnity, Pet Insurance (employee funded)
401k with 3% non-elective company contribution
Stock Options
Free Parking
Free lunch daily in office

Umbra is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We do not discriminate in hiring on the basis of sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, color, religious creed, national origin, physical or mental disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local law. U.S. Citizenship is required for all positions requiring an active U.S. Government security clearance or the ability to obtain and maintain a security clearance.

Employment Eligibility Verification

In compliance with federal laws, all hired persons will be required to verify their identity and eligibility to work in the United States by completing the required Employment Eligibility Verification Form (I-9 Form) upon hire.

ITAR/EAR Requirements

This position may include access to technology and/or data that is subject to U.S. export controls pursuant to ITAR and EAR. To comply with federal export controls, all persons hired must be a U.S. citizen, U.S. national, U.S. lawful permanent resident, refugee or asylee as defined by 8 U.S.C.

1324b(a)(3), or must otherwise be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State and/or U.S. Department of Commerce as applicable.

Pay Transparency

This job posting may cover multiple career levels. To ensure greater transparency, we provide base salary ranges for all roles, regardless of location. Our standard pay ranges are based on the role's function and level, benchmarked against similar growth-stage companies. Compensation may vary based on geographical location, as certain regions may have different cost-of-living factors. The final offer will also be influenced by the candidate's skills, responsibilities, and relevant experience.

Job Description And Duties

Are you looking for an exciting and fast-paced career? Join the California Governor's Office of Emergency Services (Cal OES) and be part of an organization that serves as a leader in emergency management and homeland security through dedicated service to all. We are looking for enthusiastic and motivated individuals to join our team. If you are interested in a challenging opportunity in a high-energy, team-oriented environment, you are encouraged to apply.

Under the general direction of the Recovery Program Manager II (PM II), the Program Manager I (PM I) performs a wide range of complex managerial and analytical tasks related to the provision of federal and state disaster assistance grant programs, including but not limited to: Public Assistance (PA) Disaster Grant, California Disaster Assistance Act (CDAA), Fire Management Assistance Grant (FMAG), Hazard Mitigation Grant Program (HMGP), Hazardous Materials Emergency Preparedness grant (HMEP), Pre-Disaster Mitigation program (PDM), Flood Mitigation Assistance (FMA), and others.

The PM I directs fully developed staff functions, supervises a small group of professional, technical or analytical staff performing journeyperson level work, and personally performs the most difficult or sensitive work. The Incumbent is responsible for management, supervision, and organization of resources, as well as the implementation of program objectives. To ensure program objectives are met, the PM I may be required to work extended hours, e.g. nights, weekends, and holidays. The PM I performs all program work and is responsible for managing staff during both normal and disaster recovery operations.

Primary management duties involve supervisorial responsibility for staff, planning, coordinating, and directing resources effectively. Duties also include developing, reviewing, and approving all program related documentation. Solicits and ensures necessary input from and coordination with all persons contacted in the course of work, makes financial, programmatic, and administrative decisions on all aspects of the program, and makes recommendations to upper management.

In alignment with the strategic plan, the PM I develops, directs, and empowers staff to ensure they are customer focused innovators and problem solvers providing a high level of service and technical expertise in their delivery of services. The PM I identifies innovative opportunities and makes recommendations for potential consideration for the strategic plan, undertakes department-wide projects, and anticipates the needs of, and impacts on disaster recovery program and operation. The PM I establishes and maintains relationships with various internal and external stakeholders, promotes organizational efficiency and operational excellence.

May be required to perform the same work tasks as subordinate staff, to ensure the mission, goals, and objectives of the unit/division/branch are met in the timeliest and most efficient manner.

This recruitment will fill (2) positions within the Closeout Division of the Recovery Closeout and Infrastructure Branch.

Closeout Unit I & II Description: Disaster Closeout implements the final step in the disaster Public Assistance process, collecting, analyzing, and validating Sub-Recipients’ disaster recovery project cost documentation and developing funding reimbursement recommendations associated with those project costs. The position performs a wide range of complex managerial and analytical tasks related to the provision of federal and state disaster assistance grant programs, including but not limited to federal Public Assistance Disaster Grants, federal Fire Management Assistance Grants, and California Disaster Assistance Act grants.

You will find additional information about the job in the Duty Statement
.

Working Conditions

This position is located in the Closeout Unit in Mather, CA

Hybrid Telework:
This position is eligible for a hybrid work schedule. Additional in office days may be required based on the business needs.

Conflict of Interest (COI):
This position is designated under the Conflict of Interest Code and is required to complete Form 700 within 30 days of appointment. Failure to comply with the Conflict of Interest Code requirements may void the appointment.

Department Information

The California Governor’s Office of Emergency Services (Cal OES) is committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive culture by hiring and retaining individuals from a variety of backgrounds and personal experiences. Our employees are empowered with the tools and resources necessary to meet our mission, while continuing to expand equity and inclusion efforts at all levels of the organization. We are committed to the spirit and work required to ensure the safety and resilience of every community in California.

Cal OES is an emergency response, homeland security, and disaster recovery agency and as a result, is a dynamic and exciting place to work in a team-oriented environment. Cal OES provides training to enhance the understanding of emergency and incident management to all employees.

The Recovery Directorate is responsible for managing disaster recovery and providing assistance to local governments, special districts, certain nonprofit organizations, individuals, businesses and agricultural communities impacted by disasters. The Recovery Directorate ensures state and federal support are provided in an efficient and timely manner throughout the recovery process.

The Recovery Directorate is comprised of three sections — Recovery Operations, Hazard Mitigation, and Interagency Recovery Coordination. Recovery personnel are responsible for assisting in the management of statewide disaster recovery efforts, as well as assisting agricultural communities, businesses, certain nonprofit organizations, individuals, local governments and special districts impacted by disasters.

In the event of an emergency, employees may be contacted and requested to report to work in the event of an emergency. This contact may be outside of your normal working hours (evenings/nights, weekends, and holidays). This service may require irregular work hours, work locations other than the official duty location, and may include duties other than those specified in your official position description. Travel requirements in support of emergency operations may be extensive in nature (weeks to months), with little advance notice, and you may be required to relocate to emergency sites.

More information may be found here: Recovery Directorate | California Governor's Office of Emergency Services

Department Website: http://www.caloes.ca.gov

Desirable Qualifications

In addition to evaluating each candidate's relative ability, as demonstrated by quality and breadth of experience, the following factors will provide the basis for competitively evaluating each candidate:

Experience performing analytical, administrative, and program support work, including researching issues and preparing reports, correspondence, briefings, memoranda, and other written materials.
Strong organizational skills, with experience tracking and coordinating multiple assignments, projects, action items, and deadlines and maintaining accurate records and tracking systems.
Experience collecting, organizing, validating, and analyzing data and program information from multiple sources to support situational awareness, reporting, and decision-making.
Proficiency in the Microsoft Office Suite (particularly Excel and Word) and familiarity with databases, dashboards, SharePoint, Smartsheet, ArcGIS Online, or other tracking and information-management tools.
Experience coordinating equipment, inventory, supplies, or logistics, including maintaining accountability, documenting assignments and returns, and preparing resources for operations, trainings, or events.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to prepare clear, professional materials and communicate effectively with diverse internal and external audiences.
Demonstrated ability to work independently with limited supervision, exercise sound judgment, take initiative, and manage competing priorities in a fast-paced environment with changing deadlines.
Experience providing coordination, outreach, and customer service support to internal and external stakeholders, including partner agencies, local jurisdictions, tribal partners, and the public.
Familiarity with emergency management or disaster recovery operations, programs, or systems (e.g., SEMS, NIMS, or SOC/REOC/JFO operations) is a plus.
Ability to handle sensitive or confidential information with discretion, tact, and good judgment.
Commitment to professionalism, dependability, integrity, and supporting a positive, mission-driven team.

Benefits

Free Parking

jobs.description:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About The Team

The Corporate Security Systems and Infrastructure (CSI) team safeguards Stripe’s people, offices, and operations by designing, delivering, and maintaining secure infrastructure across our global workplace portfolio. We take an intelligence-led, risk-based approach and partner closely with Workplace, IT, Security Operations, Legal, and external vendors to build reliable, scalable physical security systems and transition them to our Global Security Operations Center (GSOC) for ongoing monitoring and support.

What you’ll do

As a Corporate Security Infrastructure Project Manager, you will lead the security infrastructure workstream for new offices, expansions, relocations, and major workplace upgrades, with an initial focus on Europe, the Middle East, and Africa (EMEA) and support for global projects as needed. You will manage projects from early site assessment and design through installation, testing, commissioning, and operational handover.

You will be accountable for scope, schedule, budget, risk, quality, and stakeholder alignment across a portfolio of concurrent projects. In addition to delivering individual projects, you will strengthen the CSI program by improving standards, documentation, vendor performance, reporting, and repeatable project management processes. You will work through ambiguity, surface decisions early, and communicate clearly with technical teams, business partners, vendors, and senior leaders.

Responsibilities

Lead end-to-end delivery of security infrastructure for office construction and expansion projects, from site assessment and requirements definition through design, procurement, installation, testing, commissioning, and closeout.
Lead requests for proposals (RFPs) for security installations, including defining scope and requirements, coordinating bidders, reviewing submissions, evaluating proposals with relevant stakeholders, and supporting vendor selection recommendations.
Own project scope, schedule, budget, risks, dependencies, decisions, and change control; provide clear, outcome-focused reporting to stakeholders and leadership.
Coordinate security designs and technical requirements with Workplace, IT, Security Operations, Legal, architects, general contractors, landlords, and other project partners.

Maintain and improve global construction standards, technical specifications, project templates, runbooks, and closeout documentation.
Develop and track project health metrics, vendor KPIs, budget forecasts, and lessons learned; use insights to improve delivery quality, predictability, and cost efficiency.
Support new market and site evaluations by identifying security risks, infrastructure constraints, integration needs, and mitigation options.
Support the security repair and maintenance program, with a focus on the EMEA region, collaborating with regional teams to triage, track, and resolve security system and hardware issues.
Partner with CSI engineers and program leadership to prioritize work, resolve cross-project dependencies, and scale consistent processes across the portfolio.
Travel up to 25%, including international travel, to support site assessments, project milestones, commissioning, and handover.

Who you are

We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum Requirements

5+ years of project management experience delivering complex physical security, workplace technology, low-voltage, construction, or similarly technical infrastructure projects.
Demonstrated experience managing multiple concurrent projects across the full lifecycle, with ownership of scope, schedule, budget, risk, quality, and stakeholder communication.
Experience coordinating cross-functional delivery among technical teams, business partners, design and construction teams, vendors, and senior leaders.
Strong vendor and contractor management skills, including defining requirements, managing contracts or statements of work, tracking delivery, and addressing performance issues.
Excellent written and verbal communication, with the ability to translate technical details into clear decisions, risks, tradeoffs, and next steps for different audiences.
Strong judgment and structured problem-solving skills; able to operate independently, navigate ambiguity, anticipate issues, and drive timely decisions.
Meticulous attention to detail and a demonstrated commitment to accurate documentation, standards, and operational handoffs.
Experience establishing project management processes, tracking performance metrics, and applying lessons learned to improve future delivery.
Working knowledge of physical security systems such as access control, video management, intrusion detection, intercoms, low-voltage infrastructure, and door hardware.
Ability to travel internationally up to 25%.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience delivering security infrastructure for offices in multiple countries or regions, particularly in EMEA.
Experience with Genetec Security Center, including Synergis, Omnicast, Security Center SaaS, or Stratocast; active Genetec certification is a plus.
Familiarity with system integrations, networking fundamentals, APIs, webhooks, or cloud-managed security technologies.
Experience managing budgets, forecasts, vendor KPIs, SLAs, and portfolio-level reporting.
Experience using project management and workflow tools such as Jira and Smartsheet.
Experience reviewing and marking up construction and security design documentation using Bluebeam Revu or a similar PDF design-review tool, along with knowledge of commissioning practices and relevant local codes or regulatory requirements.
A bachelor’s degree in project management, construction management, security management, information technology, engineering, or a related field; or a relevant professional certification such as PMP, PRINCE2, ASIS PSP/CPP, or SIA CSPM.
Ability to select and use appropriate AI tools to improve work, while critically evaluating and refining outputs for accuracy and quality.

In-office expectations

This expectation may vary depending on role, team and location. For example, Stripes in Stripe Delivery Center roles in Mexico City, Mexico, Bengaluru, India, and Dublin, Ireland work 100% from the office. Specific benefits and details about what compensation is included in the salary range listed above will vary depending on the applicant’s location and can be discussed in more detail during the interview process. Benefits/additional compensation for this role may include: equity, company bonus or sales commissions/bonuses; retirement plans; health benefits; and wellness stipends.

Experience assisting projects and teams.

Leidos Digital Intel IT sector is seeking an IT Project Manager
to support U.S. Coast Guard digital transformation, enterprise automation, and modernization initiatives under the CG-TECH- TRT (Technical Readiness Transformation) program. This role will support planning, coordination, execution, tracking, and delivery of technology-enabled transformation initiatives, automation pilots, implementation plans, and process improvement efforts across Coast Guard mission and support functions.

The IT Project Manager will work closely with CG-TECH-TRT, mission customers, business process owners, automation developers, data teams, cybersecurity stakeholders, subcontractors, and program leadership to ensure work is planned, coordinated, documented, and delivered in alignment with Coast Guard priorities. The role will support project intake, pilot planning, schedule management, stakeholder communications, risk tracking, Agile coordination, status reporting, and delivery of minimum viable products and implementation recommendations aligned with CG-TECH-TRT objectives.

This is a hybrid position.

Primary Responsibilities

Manage day-to-day planning, coordination, execution, and tracking of TRT digital transformation, automation, and process improvement initiatives.
Support CG-TECH-TRT in managing automation use cases, pilot projects, implementation plans, schedules, milestones, dependencies, risks, issues, and action items.
Coordinate project activities across mission stakeholders, business process owners, product owners, developers, data analysts, cybersecurity teams, enterprise architects, subcontractors, and program leadership.
Develop and maintain project schedules, work plans, status trackers, action item logs, risk registers, issue logs, decision logs, assumptions, dependencies, and project documentation.

Support User Acceptance Testing planning, go-live readiness, production deployment coordination, training coordination, and post-deployment sustainment activities.
Prepare customer-facing briefings, status reports, dashboards, meeting materials, executive summaries, project artifacts, and decision-support documentation.
Support Organizational Change Management activities, including stakeholder communications, adoption planning, training coordination, fact sheets, and sustainment documentation.
Ensure project documentation is organized, version controlled, and maintained in approved repositories such as SharePoint, Teams, Jira, Confluence, or other government-approved systems.
Maintain alignment between project activities, TRT strategic priorities, Force Design 2028 objectives, automation outcomes, and measurable performance improvements.
Identify, escalate, and support mitigation of project risks, schedule delays, resource constraints, technical dependencies, stakeholder concerns, and delivery blockers.

Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Business, Project Management, Engineering, Public Administration, Operations Management, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
8+ years of experience managing IT, digital transformation, business transformation, automation, software delivery, systems implementation, or technology-enabled process improvement projects.
Experience managing project scope, schedules, milestones, risks, issues, action items, deliverables, and stakeholder communications.
Experience supporting Agile, hybrid Agile, or iterative delivery environments, including backlog management, sprint planning, demos, status reporting, and release coordination.
Experience coordinating across technical and non-technical teams, including business stakeholders, developers, analysts, cybersecurity teams, data teams, architects, and program leadership.
Experience supporting requirements-driven projects, pilot development efforts, minimum viable products, workflow automation, or modernization initiatives.
Strong understanding of project management practices, delivery governance, performance tracking, and operational reporting.
Experience preparing executive briefings, meeting materials, project status reports, dashboards, risk registers, decision logs, and project documentation.
Strong facilitation, communication, organizational, and technical writing skills, with experience briefing senior stakeholders.
Experience using collaboration, documentation, and project management tools such as Jira, Confluence, SharePoint, Service Now, Microsoft Teams, Microsoft Office, Excel, PowerPoint, Visio, Microsoft Project, or similar tools.
Must be a U.S. citizen and able to obtain and maintain a DHS Public Trust.

Preferred Qualifications

Prior experience supporting DHS, U.S. Coast Guard, DoD, or other federal government programs.
Experience supporting digital transformation, enterprise automation, business process improvement, or low-code/no-code modernization initiatives.
Familiarity with Microsoft Power Platform, ServiceNow, UiPath, Appian, Salesforce, or similar business automation platforms.
Experience supporting federal IT delivery in environments involving cybersecurity reviews, governance processes, documentation control, or deployment readiness.
